failed_products.retailer_description: The Yerba Prima Tampico Skin Brush is a wonderful, revitalizing health and beauty aid. Removing the top layer of dead skin and stimulating the circulation of blood feeding the skin are essential for maintaining youthful, glowing and supple skin. Skin Brushing has been used throughout the world for centuries, and is making its way back into popularity. Dry skin brushing is one of the best ways to cleanse the skin without removing the protective mantle of acid and oils. It gently and effectively removes the top layer of dead skin cells with its build-up of dirt and acid, and deeply cleanses the pores. Skin brushing is one of the most powerful ways to cleanse the lymphatic system. Waste material is carried away from the cells by the blood and the lymph. Skin brushing stimulates the release of this material from the cells near the surface of the body. Eventually, most of the toxins along with their carrier cells, primarily lymphocytes, find their way to the colon for elimination. Skin brushing is also used by beauty salons as part of a program for removing cellulite. Skin brushing is most effective with an all-natural vegetable fiber brush, such as the Tampico Skin Brush. Make sure the brush isn t made of synthetic fiber since this can irritate the skin. A long handle is also helpful for reaching the back and entire body.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Annie’s Cheddar Mac (as we call it!) is our answer to all those chemically orange colored cheeses out there. We’ve taken our original Shells & White Cheddar and added a little color to it, naturally! Our totally natural cheese is colored with a plant extract called annatto. Annatto has been used in tropical American cultures for generations to color foods such as butter, cheese and mustard. The annatto tree grows 20 to 30 feet in height and when its seeds are stirred in water, they produce orange annatto dye, also called achiote, to color foods. Annie’s Cheddar Macaroni and cheese is a great alternative for kids who need to have that “orange” cheese on their macaroni.

Our farm-to-table story comes from the essence of cooking hearty stock. We honor timeless, traditional cooking techniques to build flavor and nourishment, taking zero shortcuts and making no compromises. Bare Bones Broths are gelatinous when cold, fragrant when hot, loaded with nutrients, and, oh, so tasty.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: bionaturæ organic Fruit Spreads are produced using hand-harvested heirloom varieties of fruit from select regions of Italy. The term "heirloom" describes a variety of fruit, flower or vegetable that has been grown in a certain region for centuries without any hybridization. The flavor of Italian heirloom fruit is sweet, intense and true. It speaks to the pride of the farmers who produce the fruits, and cannot be duplicated anywhere else in the world. bionaturæ organic Fruit Spreads do not contain added sugar and have the lowest sugar content among leading brands. They are processed at low temperatures and cooked slowly to preserve the fruit's rich flavor and bright color. All of the fruit used in our products is grown on small family farms in remote hillside locations. Raw material can vary greatly in color, flavor and sweetness. Each batch must be reformulated to maintain a consistent and premier product. You may notice a slight variation at times in the fruit spread's flavor and appearance as this product is made in very small batches. Our fruit spreads are not made in a dedicated gluten free facility.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: From vineyard to bottling, Special Cuvée sees such an extraordinary level of care and attention, it is difficult to place within the non-vintage or, really, any Champagne category. It is a Champagne that stands apart.  Within one bottle, all the complexity of flavor, texture and pleasure that Champagne can offer.  Special Cuvée is truly a journey of devotion from Bollinger.  Bollinger is the producer most associated with a single grape variety in Champagne, namely Pinot Noir. This more difficult grape to grow makes up a minimum of 60% of all of Bollinger’s Champagne. The harmony of Pinot Noir’s richness and elegance plays a large part in Special Cuvée’s distinct profile, the ripe red berries and powerful impact a clear signature. Then there is the other association that Bollinger is so well known for: winemaking in barrel. As virtually every Champagne producer in the latter half of the 20th century moved to fermenting in large lots in stainless steel tanks, Bollinger persisted to oversee fermentation barrel by barrel for all vintage Champagnes and a remarkable 30% of Special Cuvée. Why? Because the development of flavors becomes so much more complex, and the texture rounder and silkier. A third Bollinger specialty is the aging of Champagnes. Most Champagnes on the market are primarily made up of the most recently harvested vintage before requirements to age in bottle. Bollinger is primarily made up of Champagnes that are not from the most recent vintage, and in the end a newly released bottle of Bollinger is around 7-8 years old. A fourth – and utterly distinct – practice at Bollinger is the use of Reserve Magnums. The best vineyards will be aged under cork in magnum for up to 15 years, and hand disgorged into the final blend to bring the aromas and flavors only a great aged Champagne can display, notes such as truffles, ginger and walnut. So you have it all: the freshness that Champagne brings naturally, the secondary notes as the fruit character becomes riper and savory and spicy notes enter, and the third level, when fruit becomes almost crystallized, texture becomes like velvet, and the glass in front of you brings meaning to you and with those you have chosen to share. Special Cuvée does all of this for you.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Coconut Amino make a great substitute for soy sauces. Coconut Amino have many benefits over soy-based sauces, including 14 times the amino acid content. Many soy sauces on the market are fermented by first soaking the soybeans in water and salt, and then adding specific cultures of molds, yeasts and bacteria to help catalyze the fermentation process. Coconut Amino is made from coconut tree sap, which comes right out of the tree so that vital, active and alive nutrients are blended with sun dried mineral-rich sea salt and aged, without the need for a fermentation booster or added water. Health Secrets of Coconut Amino: When the coconut tree is tapped, it produces a highly nutrient-rich "sap" that exudes from the coconut blossoms. This sap is very low glycemic (GI of only 35), is an abundant source of amino acids, minerals, vitamin C, broad-spectrum B vitamins, and has a nearly neutral PH The "Gran Moluccas Sea Salt" used in our Coconut Amino, garners its name from the exotic, tropical island of Mindanao, the 2nd largest island in the Philippines. A local culinary heritage in Mindanao, this unbleached, unrefined, naturally white sea salt, is fed only by the sun and the sea. It is hand-harvested by local salt producers working as their forefathers did, in their ancestral salt fields. Recipe Tips: Use Coconut Amino like soy sauce in dressings, marinades, sautés, and with sushi. Refrigerate after opening. "We love it so much we pour it over almost everything!" Coconut Amigos seasoning sauce is gluten free, contains 65% less sodium than soy sauce, is USDA organic, vegan and non-go.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our Lavender Facial Tonic Hydrosol is sourced from a few small, organic farms. It is distilled solely for its hydrophilic (water-loving) components, not the essential oil. Distillers of essential oils usually use plant material that has been dried over several days, resulting in a loss of approximately 70% of water volume. We choose to distill for the hydrosol alone and use only fresh plant material. In this way the resulting hydrosol is much richer in the valuable, water-soluble aromatic molecules. Furthermore, these hydrosols are artisan-distilled at low temperatures for over two to three hours. Conventional distillation utilizes high temperatures, and the process lasts for only thirty to forty-five minutes. The more labor-intensive artisan process that we choose to use creates a hydrosol that is vitalizing and healing for all skin conditions. Pure plant hydrosols are some of nature's best antioxidants. They play an important role in protecting the skin from free radicals and pollution. Saturating the skin daily with these precious waters restores pH balance, refreshes and tones skin tissue, maintaining soft and smooth skin while significantly increasing vitality and hydration to all skin conditions. Ingredients: Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Hydrosol* *ORGANIC How to use: Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol & press onto skin. Facial tonic hydrosols can be used throughout the day to tone, hydrate & refresh. As a gentle morning cleanser, simply saturate skin & pat dry with a clean cloth. For optimal hydration & moisture, combine with one of our oil serums and/or moisturizers. Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol. In palms of hands, mix dime-sized amount of oil serum and/or a finger-full of moisturizer with 5-10 more sprays of hydrosol. Gently press mixture onto skin. Finishing with a misting of hydrosol.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our Rosehip Balancing Serum is beneficial for all types of skin. It is especially effective when combined with our facial tonic hydrosols, bringing vitality & suppleness to dry, oily, combination & sun-damaged skin. Our remarkable, certified organic rosehip seed oil comes from the Chilean Andes. Known as rosa rubiginosa or rosa mosqueta, this silky oil of the rose hip seed has been used for centuries by the indigenous people of the Chilean Andes to treat burned, sun-damaged or scarred skin. Rosehip seed oil is rich in the naturally occurring pro-vitamin A and vitamin C. It has considerable amounts of polyunsaturated essential fatty acids (EFA) containing 80% gamma linolenic acid and linoleic acid. As a result it significantly regenerates and strengthens cell membranes aiding in the prevention of early signs of aging. With daily use, Rosehip Treatment Facial Serum works to minimize and soften the appearance of scars, and smooth fine lines and wrinkles. It also soothes dry, sunburned and sun-damaged skin. This Serum helps to balance excessively oily or dry skin, minimize the appearance of large pores, and purify impure skin prone to pimples. Used on a consistent basis, your skin will look smoother, fresher and more supple. Precious essential oils of rose geranium, sandalwood, rose otto & carrot seed are added to enhance the action of the rosehip seed oil. Their tiny molecular size and lipophilic (oil-loving) tendency make them ideal for curative skin treatments. Ingredients: Rosehip Seed (Rosa canina) Fruit Oil*, Jojoba (Simmondsia chinensis) Seed Oil*, Rose Geranium (Pelargonium graveolens) Oil*, Carrot (Daucus carota) Seed Essential Oil*, Hawaiian Sandalwood (Santalum paniculatum) Wood Oil*, Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Flower Oil*, Rose Otto (Rosa damascena) Flower Oil*, Vitamin E (Tocopherol) *ORGANIC How to use: Use oil serum & HydroSoul together. Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol. In palms of hands, mix dime-sized amount of oil serum with 5-10 more sprays of hydrosol. Gently press mixture onto skin evenly distributing between cheeks, forehead & chin. Finish with a misting of hydrosol. For drier skin, follow with one of our occlusive moisturizers.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: THE HEADBAND | This twist headband for men is a top seller and for good reason. For starters, it's made from ridiculously soft, sweat-wicking and breathable organic cotton. A warning: once you go organic, you'll never be able to wear a synthetic (read: plastic) headband again. Second, it works. We designed the sweatband with a twist that sits at the nape of the neck, keeping the headband from slipping during even the sweatiest workout. This design, coupled with the sweat-wicking organic cotton, means no more headband slipping during your workouts. Third, it's versatile. Choose to wear the headband thin like a tennis headband, scrunched for a rocker-headband or opened wide for a full bandana head covering, Last but not least, it's ethically made. Read more about this last point in the "About KOOSHOO" section below. MATERIALS | The body of this twist headwrap is made from 93% organic cotton and 7% spandex. CARE | For longest life, wash the headband cold and lay flat to dry. The headband is color stable and will also be fine in the dryer. ABOUT KOOSHOO | KOOSHOO is an eco-friendly clothing and accessories brand created by husband and wife yoga teachers to help others feel good (KOOSHOO literally means "feeling good"). We make organic headbands, the world's ONLY plastic-free hairties, stylish shawls and baby plants that grow with a child. We always use the finest organic and natural materials, ethically manufacture in certified facilities, dye using low-impact azo-free dyes and package in 100% recycled and/or biodegradable packaging. We're a small business run by real people that care deeply about our customers, suppliers and the environment. We stand 100% behind our products (full refunds and/or exchanges if not stoked) and every time a sale is made, the team does a happy dance in honor of the customer.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: A gentle, creamy body wash infused with Goat's Milk, Shea Butter, Chai, and Rose Extracts, that cleanses while keeping skin feeling hydrated and soft to reveal a radiant look. This Body cleanser lathers and diffuses elegant and floral notes for a soothing ambiance. Heritage: Ancient images of roses on Egyptian and Abyssinian tomb walls date back to 500 BC. Inspired by the softening rose and milk baths of Cleopatra, this modern interpretation highlights these well-documented skincare additives. Chai, the word for tea in Swahili, is integral to the cultural and social fabric of many civilizations. Rich in antioxidants, Chai helps nourish the skin to maintain a more youthful looking appearance. Usage instructions: Apply this body and face wash to a washcloth or hands and work into a lather to cleanse the entire body. Rinse completely. Humble Beginnings: Nubian Heritage has been guided by the legacy of ancient Nubia, the world's first melting pot. Ancient Nubia was once a center of cultural trade - a place where goods, ideas, and customs from across Africa, Asia, the Middle East and the Mediterranean came together, influenced each other, and then spread across the ancient world. That is our inspiration.

Leave skin soft and renewed.Humble BeginningsNubian Heritage is the brainchild of two New York street vendors. In 1992, fresh out of college and without jobs, Rich and Nyema embarked on a mission to produce luxurious natural products from traditional African recipes with fair trade ingredients. Today Nubian Heritage offers culturally authentic natural products inspired by global ancient healing philosophies. Although Nubian Heritage products are no longer made in bath tubs, little else has changed; the company still makes its products, still uses fair trade ingredients and still invests in community commerce.HeritageA time honored Asian beauty secret, Patchouli relaxes and soothes the senses while Buriti Oil, made from the fruit of Buriti Palm, known as the "tree of life", hydrates and rejuvenates skin's appearance. Social and environmental responsibility is a core part of Nutiva’s culture and business. Morton Gothelf, the founder of Morton & Bassett Spices, had always been a great cook and always seemed to be entertaining friends. In searching for superior ingredients, he found that the best quality spices were difficult to obtain in a typical grocery or gourmet store. Morton began to find sources for the best spices and then started Morton & Bassett Spices in 1986, hoping to fill this niche. The combination of great ingredients, good value and clear bottles that showcased the product was a hit. Since 1986 the business has grown quickly thanks to the growing numbers of loyal Morton & Bassett customers. Once a good cook tries Morton & Bassett they inevitably become loyal fans. Today there are over 100 world class spices in the product line and more flavors are in the works.

The reason why the majority of other brands use Quilon coated parchment paper is because the cost is substantially lower than using silicone coating. Like all our paper products, our Parchment Paper is totally chlorine-free, so no chlorine or chlorine derivatives are dumped into our lakes, rivers, and streams. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Colombia Dark Roast Coffee is for those seeking exceptional, full-bodied Colombian coffee, shining and sweet from the rarest lots. Colombia is synonymous with good coffee, and the country produces more washed Arabica beans than any other. But while the overall quality is consistent and familiar to the American palate, Colombia also produces exceptional coffees from specific micro-climates. Not one but three cordilleras traverse this enormous, emerald country and the variety of sun and rain regimes mean that harvesting is going on somewhere almost throughout the year. As always, we select by the cup, seeking the rarest lots of the brightest, sweetest, most exceptional beans. Our favorite, flavorful, full-bodied Colombian coffee comes from the heights of the remote southern province of Huila, a region that still grows the traditional typica beans along with the newer varieties. At the massif of two ranges, and the headwaters of a river that flows 950 miles north to the Caribbean, a small group of growers produce a shining, sweet and delicately fruited Colombia that has a taste unto its own.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: �On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

Raw Organic Meal is a great choice for those who seek highly nutritious meal replacement & protein drinks. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our Beginnings. When our founder, Steven, and his wife, Sara Jade, became parents, they placed a newfound value on living a more natural, sustainable lifestyle. In Sara Jade’s search for clean personal care products, she became frustrated by confusing natural claims and long, complicated ingredient lists, and learned that only products with an organic certification can be trusted to be pure, less processed, and more effective than commonly available alternatives. This inspired them to create their own products, and Sky Organics was born. Simple, Botanically-Based Solutions. Our products are thoughtfully curated to complement and enhance your clean beauty routine, and are formulated with as few ingredients as possible. We only include ingredients that we know will effectively deliver desired benefits, and we offer many single-ingredient products because that is often all that is truly needed to effectively care for skin, hair, lashes, or eyebrows. Integrity and Transparency. Because organic is known to be the cleanest form of natural and is clearly defined and certified, we seek out organic ingredients whenever available. We know for certain that our ingredients are sustainably grown, harvested without chemicals or synthetic fillers, and maintain their natural integrity and potency. When we do occasionally use a non-organic ingredient, it’s always a thoughtful choice that weighs the ingredient’s beauty benefit versus its organic availability, and we clearly communicate this on our product labels. Created for All. It's important to us that clean, natural, organic solutions are available to and affordable for as many people as possible, regardless of who they are, what they look like, or where they live. With this in mind, we offer self care essentials for every skin type and hair type, with a wide variety of beauty benefits and uses. Join Our Journey. We invite you to redefine your everyday approach to beauty and embrace a more hopeful world with Sky Organics.

data_issues.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

duplicateish_groups.retailer_description: Super Absorbent: Our Liners, Pads, and Tampons are all super absorbent, leak-proof protection for your flow. Susan & Tara met on their first day of their master's program at LSE and fell into an instant best friendship. The idea for the business started on a classic BFF bathroom trip between lectures. Susan wanted to start a Fempire to take on the toxic patriarchy bros, while Tara couldn't find organic tampons anywhere in the UK. Susan was like, 'Organic tampons? Why do you even need those? A long chat about the impact of synthetic fibers and harsh chemicals, many late nights, and a master's dissertation later, and Here We Flo was born. We are a proudly female owned and led, B-CORP business on a mission to empower people with periods to feel crazy confident even when it’s messy. At Here We Flo, we treat period care as personal care, not sanitary hygiene. Because your vagina deserves better. We create “better for you” accessible upgrades for period, pee, and pleasure that are better for vaginas + vulvas. Using materials that you can trust to work. No drama. No bad vibes. Just premium vulva experiences. Crazy confidence is all about how you feel inside. So we fight shame and stigma around periods, pee, and pleasure with a funny, feminist, + fierce personality and empower our community with actually useful information. We’re also committed to giving 5% of profits back to people + planet. Welcome to the Fempire, bestie.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Fourth and Heart's grass-fed ghee is very lightly salted and gently whipped to add flavor to just about anything. Ghee is a type of clarified butter that is heated, reduced & triple-filtered out and what you’re left with is the pure healthy fat, which is lactose free & dairy free, good for digestion and metabolism. It is an iconic ingredient and food staple with a history as rich as its taste. It originates in India and is used extensively in cooking and to promote health. Ghee alone is an excellent alternative to butter for those who are lactose intolerant and who want the taste of butter, without the disadvantages of processed margarines. Unlike other oils it is rich in butyric acid, a short chain fatty acid that is great for your overall health and digestion. Ghee’s buttery taste and high smoke point (485 degrees) makes it an excellent addition to your everyday cooking oils, is extremely easy to cook with and delicious simply spread on a piece of toast. Fourth & Heart grass-fed ghee uses the highest quality grass-fed butter sourced from a cooperative of farms in New Zealand. Grass is naturally high in Vitamin A, D, E, K and CLA. When the cow’s milk is rich with these vitamins it goes directly to the butter and therefor the ghee. Replace your everyday butter & oil with 100% Grass-Fed Pure Spreadable Butter. Please note: ghee naturally melts at approximately 90-degrees farenheit, which can occur during transit and delivery. This is perfectly normal and will not damage the ghee, which will resolidify if left at room temperature or refrigerated for 2-3 hours. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Amy's Organic Medium Chili with Vegetables is made from organic red beans, organic bell peppers, potatoes, carrots, corn and tofu. Amy's organic chili is a hearty plant-based chili that everyone will enjoy. Our medium chili is made with high-quality, organic ingredients, so you can feel good about serving this vegetarian food as a delicious appetizer, side dish, dinner or lunch option. It's gluten free, dairy free, lactose free and vegan-friendly, making it a great option for those with dietary restrictions or preferences. This canned chili is also easy to prepare: simply heat it up on the stove or in the microwave and serve. It's perfect for busy weeknights or lazy weekends when you want to enjoy a warm and comforting meal without spending hours in the kitchen. With its delicious flavor, Amy's Organic Medium Chili with Vegetables will surely become a kitchen favorite. Since 1987, Amy's Kitchen has produced delicious, convenient organic food for people who are sometimes too busy to cook.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Amy's Organic Medium Chili is made from organic red beans and tofu simmered in a thick, flavorful Mexican-style broth. This is for those who want big chili flavor without all of the big, bite-for-bite heat! Easy to prepare, this Amy's Organic Medium Chili contains soy, is gluten free, dairy free, lactose free, tree nut free and corn free. It is also suitable for vegan and kosher diets. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: GOODNESS IS OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLE. We choose what's best for our customers, our farmers, our employees and our planet. It's a tall order, but we wouldn't have it any other way. We're not in the business of making shareholders happy. In fact, we don't have shareholders. We're in the business of cooking delicious, organic vegetarian meals for everyone. We were organic before it was a national certification. So when the U.S. Department of Agriculture decided to create standards for organic, they looked to us for guidance. Together with other industry leaders, we helped pioneer the organic food industry and, more importantly, we helped make organic food available to more people. All of our dishes are non-GMO and we're a proud supporter of GMO labeling initiatives. Because we believe that people have a right to know what they put in their bodies. We were also the first to market with non-BPA-lined cans, and we're happy to see many other food companies following our lead.

Our 14.1 ounce can of soup is crafted with organic coconut milk, sweet potatoes, carrots, tofu, soybeans, green beans, sauteed onions and shitake mushrooms. Each can of gluten-free, all-vegan soup contains absolutely no preservatives while being packed with 2 grams of dietary fiber and 4 grams of protein per serving. Our soup is certified organic, Non-GMO and is packaged in non-bpa lined cans, so you can be sure that what you get is the real deal. See nutritional facts panel for allergens. Amy's kitchen has grown beyond the berliner family's wildest dreams, going from several family members pitching in anywhere they can, to a wonderful group of employees, farmers and suppliers. One thing will always remain the same--the family spirit that permeates every decision made inside of amy's kitchen.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Amy's Indian Golden Lentil Soup starts with organic red lentils and yellow split peas, which are cooked with organic carrots, tomatoes and traditional, mild spices. Try serving this delicious soup, as a quick and simple appetizer, with sandwich rounds for easy dipping. Convenient and easy to prepare and serve, this Amy's Indian Golden Lentil Soup is gluten free, dairy and lactose free, soy free, tree nut free and corn free. It is also suitable for vegan and kosher diets. Since 1987, we at Amy’s Kitchen have produced delicious, convenient foods for people who are sometimes too busy to cook. Amy’s is a family-run business, and we supervise every aspect of our business and take pride in customer satisfaction. All the fruits, vegetables and grains we use are grown without the use of insecticides, GMOs and other harmful chemicals. We prepare these ingredients with the same careful attention in our kitchen as you would in your own home for high-quality, home-style vegetarian and vegan meals. No meat, fish, shellfish, poultry, eggs or peanuts are used in any Amy's products. Even though you're heating up our meals in your home, we want each bite to taste like you're a guest in ours.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Annie’s Cheddar Mac (as we call it!) is our answer to all those chemically orange colored cheeses out there. We’ve taken our original Shells & White Cheddar and added a little color to it, naturally! Our totally natural cheese is colored with a plant extract called annatto. Annatto has been used in tropical American cultures for generations to color foods such as butter, cheese and mustard. The annatto tree grows 20 to 30 feet in height and when its seeds are stirred in water, they produce orange annatto dye, also called achiote, to color foods. Annie’s Cheddar Macaroni and cheese is a great alternative for kids who need to have that “orange” cheese on their macaroni.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers provide the perfect alternative for those who want to enjoy the taste of craft beer without the hangover. Whether you’re craving a crisp IPA, a smooth golden, or a light, refreshing brew, we offer a wide range of styles to satisfy your taste buds. Made with the finest ingredients, our beers include malted barley, hops, yeast, water, and wheat, ensuring a well-balanced, flavorful brew. The secret behind our great taste lies in our careful brewing method, which allows us to craft each Non Alcoholic beer with the same passion and precision as traditional craft brews, while maintaining the same flavor. Perfect for those looking for a mindful alcohol alternative, our beers contain less than 0.5% alcohol by volume, making them suitable for any time of the day. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers are designed for active, health-conscious individuals who love the taste of brews but want to make mindful choices. Our Non Alcoholic beer selection includes classics like Run Wild IPA, Upside Dawn Golden, Athletic Lite, and Free Wave, with regular releases of unique styles and experimental brews that showcase our passion for innovation. Each brew is carefully crafted to provide the same depth of flavor you’d expect from a traditional craft beer, without the unwanted effects. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beer is your go-to drink. It’s a great fit for any lifestyle, whether you’re indulging in pizza, a salad, or grilling. Perfectly paired with a variety of meals, desserts, and activities, it’s a refreshing choice for anyone who wants to enjoy the taste of beer without the alcohol. With a variety of styles to choose from, including hazy IPAs and light and dark brews, there’s a flavor to suit every palate. From casual drinking to special occasions, Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers let you enjoy the best of both worlds: the refreshing taste of craft beer and the benefits of choosing a Non Alcoholic beverage.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Badia a Coltibuono, or "the Abbey of good harvest," lies in the heart of the Chianti Classico area, between Florence and Siena. The Abbey is approximately two thousand years old, but history records date the property back to the Etruscan civilizations of the 3rd century BC. Today, the estate is composed of vineyards, chestnut, walnut and olive trees, all of them lying on one of the best sites in the Chianti area, where the soil is very rich and the climate is mild and sunny all year round. Badia a Coltibuono is very proud to produce some of Tuscany's finest and most noble wines.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: With a confetti of crunchy caramel pieces and fine sea salt, Tony's Chocolonely Caramel Sea Salt Milk Chocolate Bar is the life of the party. Our classic 32% milk chocolate is all dressed up with all-natural, non-GMO ingredients and made with traceable cocoa. Most importantly, our Fairtrade Certified chocolate exists to support the wellbeing of cocoa farmers and their families. Each bar has a dynamic, uneven pattern that helps us tell an important story about the inequality along the chocolate supply chain. Share a bar of our fun, crunchy milk chocolate and in doing so, help us share our recipe for slave-free chocolate. Includes one 1.7 oz. Caramel Sea Salt Milk Chocolate Bar. Right now, slaves are working on cocoa farms in West Africa. Many of them are children. Tony's Chocolonely exists to change that. Our vision is 100% slave-free chocolate. Not just our chocolate, but all chocolate worldwide. With incredibly tasty chocolate, we lead by example to show the world chocolate can be made differently. The more people choose slave-free and share our story, the sooner 100% slave-free becomes the norm in chocolate. The choice is yours. Are you in?

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Bare Bones Grass-Fed Lemon Ginger Bone Broth Instant Mix is perfect for school, the office, travel, backpacking, and beyond. Its aromatic, delicious flavor makes it the perfect sipping snack. These paleo and keto-friendly "rip sticks" pack the perfect serving of protein, collagen, and prebiotic fiber to fuel you on the go. Just rip, mix with hot water, and sip. Our bone broth warms the soul and nourishes the body, just like Grandma's homemade soup, but now in a convenient instant mix. Made with real bone broth, ground herbs, and spices, our bone broth is traditionally simmered low and slow for 14+ hours to extract protein, collagen, vitamins, and amino acids for the best flavor and nutrition. Enjoy this nutritional broth as a substitute for stock in your favorite recipes, as some added flavor to rice and soup, or as a sipping snack straight from a mug. No artificial flavorings, MSG, antibiotics, growth stimulants, or hormones. Gluten-free, soy-free, paleo, and keto-friendly. Created to inspire people to eat for health and longevity, Bare Bones Bone Broth was founded in 2014 by the health-conscious duo Ryan and Katherine Harvey. Our farm-to-table story comes from the essence of cooking hearty stock. We honor timeless, traditional cooking techniques to build flavor and nourishment, taking zero shortcuts and making no compromises. Bare Bones Broths are gelatinous when cold, fragrant when hot, loaded with nutrients, and, oh, so tasty.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: At Beyond Meat we believe there is a better way to feed our future and that the positive choices we all make, no matter how small, can have a great impact on our personal health and the health of our planet. By shifting from animal to plant-based meat, we can positively impact four growing global issues: human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources, and animal welfare. How Our Products Are Made: We source the building blocks of meat directly from plants. Using heating, cooling and pressure, we create the fibrous texture of meat from plant-based proteins. Uncompromisingly delicious plant-based burgers, sausage, and more, no sacrifice required.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: It was back in the summer of '93 when I was first enlightened with the idea of making candles. My good buddy heft and I were hiking along the rugged shoreline of the Olympic Peninsula. On our first evening, as the final rays of sunshine dipped below the horizon, we breathed deep of the fresh ocean air and fixed our gazes upon the emerging stars. After several hours of philosophical banter on the meaning of life, my eyes settled on the most recognizable Beacon in the northern sky,the big Dipper. Suddenly my future flashed before my eyes. I would use elements of nature, which I so respect, to create a natural source of light. Handdippedbeeswax candles. And so big dipperwax works was born. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: It was back in the summer of '93 when I was first enlightened with the idea of making candles. My good buddy heft and I were hiking along the rugged shoreline of the Olympic Peninsula. On our first evening, as the final rays of sunshine dipped below the horizon, we breathed deep of the fresh ocean air and fixed our gazes upon the emerging stars. After several hours of philosophical banter on the meaning of life, my eyes settled on the most recognizable Beacon in the northern sky,the big Dipper. Suddenly my future flashed before my eyes. I would use elements of nature, which I so respect, to create a natural source of light. Handdippedbeeswax candles. And so big dipperwax works was born. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: bionaturæ organic Fruit Spreads are produced using hand-harvested heirloom varieties of fruit from select regions of Italy. The term "heirloom" describes a variety of fruit, flower or vegetable that has been grown in a certain region for centuries without any hybridization. The flavor of Italian heirloom fruit is sweet, intense and true. It speaks to the pride of the farmers who produce the fruits, and cannot be duplicated anywhere else in the world. bionaturæ organic Fruit Spreads do not contain added sugar and have the lowest sugar content among leading brands. They are processed at low temperatures and cooked slowly to preserve the fruit's rich flavor and bright color. All of the fruit used in our products is grown on small family farms in remote hillside locations. Raw material can vary greatly in color, flavor and sweetness. Each batch must be reformulated to maintain a consistent and premier product. You may notice a slight variation at times in the fruit spread's flavor and appearance as this product is made in very small batches. Our fruit spreads are not made in a dedicated gluten free facility.

Our mission is to stimulate the evolution of health care by promoting homeopathy as a compassionate, ecological and comprehensive approach to medicine. At Boiron, we believe there's more than one way to feel better. Since 1932, the Boiron family has been committed to providing quality medicines. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: From vineyard to bottling, Special Cuvée sees such an extraordinary level of care and attention, it is difficult to place within the non-vintage or, really, any Champagne category. It is a Champagne that stands apart.  Within one bottle, all the complexity of flavor, texture and pleasure that Champagne can offer.  Special Cuvée is truly a journey of devotion from Bollinger.  Bollinger is the producer most associated with a single grape variety in Champagne, namely Pinot Noir. This more difficult grape to grow makes up a minimum of 60% of all of Bollinger’s Champagne. The harmony of Pinot Noir’s richness and elegance plays a large part in Special Cuvée’s distinct profile, the ripe red berries and powerful impact a clear signature. Then there is the other association that Bollinger is so well known for: winemaking in barrel. As virtually every Champagne producer in the latter half of the 20th century moved to fermenting in large lots in stainless steel tanks, Bollinger persisted to oversee fermentation barrel by barrel for all vintage Champagnes and a remarkable 30% of Special Cuvée. Why? Because the development of flavors becomes so much more complex, and the texture rounder and silkier. A third Bollinger specialty is the aging of Champagnes. Most Champagnes on the market are primarily made up of the most recently harvested vintage before requirements to age in bottle. Bollinger is primarily made up of Champagnes that are not from the most recent vintage, and in the end a newly released bottle of Bollinger is around 7-8 years old. A fourth – and utterly distinct – practice at Bollinger is the use of Reserve Magnums. The best vineyards will be aged under cork in magnum for up to 15 years, and hand disgorged into the final blend to bring the aromas and flavors only a great aged Champagne can display, notes such as truffles, ginger and walnut. So you have it all: the freshness that Champagne brings naturally, the secondary notes as the fruit character becomes riper and savory and spicy notes enter, and the third level, when fruit becomes almost crystallized, texture becomes like velvet, and the glass in front of you brings meaning to you and with those you have chosen to share. Special Cuvée does all of this for you.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Effortlessly craft extraordinary meals with Pacific Foods Low Sodium Organic Beef Broth. We slow-simmer humanely raised organic beef with onions, garlic and a touch of sea salt for a savory beef broth with 140mg of sodium per serving. Easier to prepare than beef bouillon, this low sodium broth is a delectably simple and nuanced canvas for your favorite dishes. Use it in any recipe that calls for low sodium beef broth, beef stock or water. It’s great as a soup base and for crafting delectable stews and ramen. It also elevates gravies, sauces and marinades, and it enhances the cooking of grains, protein and veggies. Each 32 oz recyclable carton contains approximately 4 servings of our gluten free and USDA Certified Organic broth. In addition to using it for cooking, you can enjoy this savory beef broth on its own as a simple yet flavorful beef soup. Customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a sandwich, salad or wrap. In addition to beef broth, Pacific Foods also offers chicken broth, turkey broth, vegetable broth and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience layers of nourishing flavor with Pacific Foods Organic Unsalted Chicken Bone Broth. We slow-simmer organic chicken bones and apple cider vinegar for a savory bone broth that’s full of naturally occurring collagen without high sodium. This organic chicken broth is great for refueling after workouts or beating the afternoon doldrums. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, add a slice of lemon, ginger or some fresh herbs. Our USDA-certified organic bone broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free ofgluten. It may also be suitable for paleo and keto diets. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Chicken Bone Broth contains 10 grams of protein, less than 1 gram of carbs and 50 calories. Try it as a soup base or to cook grains and veggies. Pacific Foods also offers chicken bone broth with sea salt and beef bone broth with sea salt. At Pacific Foods, we’re dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients. (*Not a sodium free food)

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Effortlessly craft extraordinary meals with Pacific Foods Organic Free-Range Chicken Broth. We slow-simmer organic free-range chicken with sea salt and just the right amount of seasonings for a savory organic chicken broth that’s rich and full of flavor. Easier to prepare than chicken bouillon, this broth is a delectably simple and nuanced canvas for your favorite dishes. Use it in any recipe that calls for 1 cup of chicken broth, chicken stock or water. It’s great as a soup base and for crafting delectable stews and ramen. It also elevates gravies, sauces and marinades, and it enhances the cooking of grains, potatoes and veggies. Each 8 oz recyclable carton contains a single serving of our gluten free and USDA Certified Organic broth. In addition to using it for cooking, you can enjoy this savory chicken broth on its own as a simple yet flavorful chicken soup. Customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a sandwich, salad or wrap. In addition to chicken broth, Pacific Foods also offers beef broth, turkey broth, vegetable broth and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: California Olive Ranch 100% Extra Virgin Olive Oil is crafted locally from our Californian farmers in California. This olive oil is made from cold-pressing olives to extract their natural oils. Other “light” or “pure” olive oil is made using excessive heat or chemicals which alter the taste and quality of the olive oil. We never use high heat or solvents in our EVOO, ensuring you get gourmet-quality. This accessible gourmet EVOO features well-rounded notes of a floral, buttery and fruity taste. Home chefs like you use it for marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Using olive oil as a part of your daily diet may promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether it is for a sweet or savory dish. As an added bonus, our extra virgin olive oils are verified non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project, and certified kosher by Orthodox Union. They are also Whole30 approved, certified paleo, keto verified, and vegan friendly. All oils at California Olive Ranch are certified "Extra Virgin" by Applied Sensory, passing both rigid chemical and sensory evaluations. Our delicious olive oil is the only oil you need in your kitchen.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Coconut Amino make a great substitute for soy sauces. Coconut Amino have many benefits over soy-based sauces, including 14 times the amino acid content. Many soy sauces on the market are fermented by first soaking the soybeans in water and salt, and then adding specific cultures of molds, yeasts and bacteria to help catalyze the fermentation process. Coconut Amino is made from coconut tree sap, which comes right out of the tree so that vital, active and alive nutrients are blended with sun dried mineral-rich sea salt and aged, without the need for a fermentation booster or added water. Health Secrets of Coconut Amino: When the coconut tree is tapped, it produces a highly nutrient-rich "sap" that exudes from the coconut blossoms. This sap is very low glycemic (GI of only 35), is an abundant source of amino acids, minerals, vitamin C, broad-spectrum B vitamins, and has a nearly neutral PH The "Gran Moluccas Sea Salt" used in our Coconut Amino, garners its name from the exotic, tropical island of Mindanao, the 2nd largest island in the Philippines. A local culinary heritage in Mindanao, this unbleached, unrefined, naturally white sea salt, is fed only by the sun and the sea. It is hand-harvested by local salt producers working as their forefathers did, in their ancestral salt fields. Recipe Tips: Use Coconut Amino like soy sauce in dressings, marinades, sautés, and with sushi. Refrigerate after opening. "We love it so much we pour it over almost everything!" Coconut Amigos seasoning sauce is gluten free, contains 65% less sodium than soy sauce, is USDA organic, vegan and non-go.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt—the chocolate bar that delivers the perfect combination of rich dark chocolate and a delightful crunch! Packed with 51% cocoa and whole almonds, each bite offers a perfect balance of bold, robust dark chocolate and the satisfying crunch of almonds, all beautifully enhanced by a touch of sea salt. It’s the ultimate chocolate experience for anyone who loves the deep flavor of dark chocolate and the perfect contrast of salty and sweet! At Tony’s, we believe chocolate should be more than just a tasty indulgence—it should make a difference. That’s why we’re on a mission to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. Every bar of Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the 51% cocoa dark chocolate, followed by the satisfying crunch of almonds and a touch of sea salt to elevate the flavors. Whether you’re having a sweet snack, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of bold chocolate, crunchy nuts, and a hint of salt, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Dave's Killer Bread® Cinnamon Raisin Remix® Bagels are USDA organic cinnamon raisin bagels with killer taste and texture to mix up your morning routine. 12g protein and 11g whole grains per bagel. These sweet and cinnamony organic bagels have no high-fructose corn syrup, no artificial ingredients. You can trust Dave's Killer Bread® to deliver killer taste, texture and whole grain nutrition. Cinnamon Raisin Remix® bagels are pre-sliced and ready to be slathered in smooth cream cheese or butter. Remix for your morning with Dave's Killer Bread® Cinnamon Raisin Remix® bagels. The story of Dave’s Killer Bread® began at the Portland Farmers Market, when Dave Dahl and his nephew brought some loaves of Dave's bread to sell. For Dave, this marked the beginning of a new chapter in his life. Though he grew up in a family of bakers, his life took a different path. A path that landed him in prison for 15 years. Determined to prove his worth and make a positive impact, Dave worked tirelessly to bake breads that tasted unlike anything else on the market — packed with seeds and grains, made with only the very best organic and Non-GMO Project Verified ingredients. Dave’s Killer Bread® believes everyone is capable of greatness. One in three of the company's employee partners at their Milwaukie, OR bakery has a criminal background—but your past doesn't define your future. As a proud Second Chance Employer, Dave’s Killer Bread® truly believes everyone deserves a second chance to become a Good Seed.

This pasta can be used in thick creamy or velvety soups. Available in 16.0 oz pack.

In the past, Fusilli were made by hand according to a method that was passed down from one generation to the next. You had to rapidly twist a strand of spaghetti around a knitting needle with a skilled hand. The ability required to perform this procedure is reminiscent of that of spinners and as a matter of fact, the term "fusillo" comes from "fuso" (spindle) which was the tool used by spinners. Penne Rigate are part of the short, diagonal cut, ridged pasta family and are one of the most well-known type of pasta, as well as being the most versatile in the kitchen. In Italian, the term "Penne" refers to the goose feather which was used historically to write with and was cut on a diagonal to achieve a really thin tip. The shape, obtained from a pasta tube, can be smooth or ridged, of varying length and has the typical diagonal cut of a quill. Penne are one of the few types of pasta for which there is an exact date when it was created. Indeed, in 1865, a pasta-maker from San Martino d'Albaro (Genoa), Giovanni Battista Capurro, requested and obtained a patent for a diagonal cutting machine. The patent was important because it meant the fresh pasta could be cut like a quill without crushing it and in different lengths from 3 to 5 centimetres (mezze "half" penne or penne). The document preserved in the Central Archive of the State of Rome reads: "Up until now, a diagonal cut could only be made by hand with a pair of scissors which, in addition to being slow and time-consuming, also resulted in an irregular cut which flattened the pasta". Penne Rigate are perfect for preparing oven-baked pasta or pasta dishes served with meat sauces made from pork or beef. This pasta is equally as good with vegetable based sauces and more in general, due to its versatility, for any recipe from the Mediterranean tradition, such as the classic condiment with tomato, basil, extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. A classic combination is with Arrabbiata sauce. Available in 16.0 oz and 5 lb.

Historically, official mention of the term "spaghetto" can be traced back to the first dictionary of the Italian language by Nicolò Tommaseo and Bernardo Bellini (1819). The word "spaghetto" was included as the "masculine singular diminutive of spago (thread)" and mention is made of "Minestra di Spaghetti" (spaghetti soup) which is pasta the size of a long, thin thread such as sopracapellini". An interesting fact: in 1957, the BBC aired the first documentary on the production of spaghetti and the day after, the television studios were inundated by phone calls from viewers asking for the name of the producers and distributors of spaghetti so they could buy some. Spaghetti is so versatile that it can be served with any condiment, from fish to meat, from vegetables to cheese, but is also excellent served just with extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Visibly firm, lift and smooth skin with this skin-firming formula. Rich in moisture and nutrients, this nourishing cream contains ingredients shown to help addressing loss of elasticity. Our formula contains DMAE, known as nature's firming agent, Alpha Lipoic Acid, known as the universal antioxidant and C-Ester plus moisturizing Jojoba Oil and nourishing Vitamins A and E. This replenishing formula leaves skin thoroughly hydrated, nourished and firmer-looking. Ideal for those who are looking to visibly firm and lift the face or neck. 100% vegan, cruelty-free, paraben-free, sulfate-free, mineral oil-free, lanolin-free, gluten-free, GMO-free. Please Note: DMAE and Alpha Lipoic Acid are highly effective ingredients that may cause an adverse reaction on some skin types. Before starting regular use, we recommend conducting a “patch test” for sensitivity on a small area under the ear below the jaw line. If your skin shows an adverse reaction, discontinue use immediately. Please note that DERMA E is in a packaging transition. There is a chance your products will arrive in the older package instead of new, please know that we assure you it is the same great formula with effective results.

All you have to do is dilute the liquid soap for best results and multiple uses. The 18-in-1 Hemp Almond Pure-Castile Liquid Soap from Dr. Bronner’s comes in a 16-ounce bottle, packaged in a 100% post-consumer recycled bottle, and completely free of synthetic preservatives, detergents or foaming agents. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience a rich, nourishing lather with Dr. Bronner’s Magic Bar Soap—crafted with Regenerative Organic Certified Oils and thoughtfully formulated for a full-body clean that’s gentle yet effective. Gentle and Effective Organic Ingredients Dr. Bronner’s bar soaps are made with vegan ingredients—no chelating agents, dyes, whiteners, or synthetic fragrances. These plant-based formulas offer a clean you can trust, free from harsh chemicals and suitable for sensitive skin and all ages (though not tear-free, so keep it out of little eyes!). No Synthetic Dyes or Detergents Our Pure-Castile Bar Soaps contain no synthetic dyes, detergents, or foaming agents. Just creamy, effective suds from organic coconut, palm, olive, and hemp oils that rinse clean while leaving skin soft, smooth, and nourished. Eco-Friendly Packaging Every bar is wrapped in post-consumer recycled paper, helping reduce waste and support global recycling efforts. This sustainable packaging choice diverts paper from landfills and speaks to our commitment to the planet. Regenerative Organic Certified We source our ingredients from fairly paid farmers who practice regenerative organic agriculture, including intercropping, composting, and reforestation. Every bar supports ecosystems, ethical supply chains, and the future of our soil. Elevate Your Clean with Dr. Bronner’s – The Original All-One Magic Bar Soap and More!

The beauty sponge and makeup brush are easy to clean with our EcoTools Brush + Sponge Shampoo for improved brush and sponge performance. EcoTools believes in taking the guesswork out of sustainability by making quality, eco-conscious personal care products accessible to everyone. To begin, our miso craftsmen age certified organic soybeans with rice "koji", which is organic rice made "active" by a traditional starter culture. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our Lavender Facial Tonic Hydrosol is sourced from a few small, organic farms. It is distilled solely for its hydrophilic (water-loving) components, not the essential oil. Distillers of essential oils usually use plant material that has been dried over several days, resulting in a loss of approximately 70% of water volume. We choose to distill for the hydrosol alone and use only fresh plant material. In this way the resulting hydrosol is much richer in the valuable, water-soluble aromatic molecules. Furthermore, these hydrosols are artisan-distilled at low temperatures for over two to three hours. Conventional distillation utilizes high temperatures, and the process lasts for only thirty to forty-five minutes. The more labor-intensive artisan process that we choose to use creates a hydrosol that is vitalizing and healing for all skin conditions. Pure plant hydrosols are some of nature's best antioxidants. They play an important role in protecting the skin from free radicals and pollution. Saturating the skin daily with these precious waters restores pH balance, refreshes and tones skin tissue, maintaining soft and smooth skin while significantly increasing vitality and hydration to all skin conditions. Ingredients: Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Hydrosol* *ORGANIC How to use: Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol & press onto skin. Facial tonic hydrosols can be used throughout the day to tone, hydrate & refresh. As a gentle morning cleanser, simply saturate skin & pat dry with a clean cloth. For optimal hydration & moisture, combine with one of our oil serums and/or moisturizers. Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol. In palms of hands, mix dime-sized amount of oil serum and/or a finger-full of moisturizer with 5-10 more sprays of hydrosol. Gently press mixture onto skin. Finishing with a misting of hydrosol.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our Rosehip Balancing Serum is beneficial for all types of skin. It is especially effective when combined with our facial tonic hydrosols, bringing vitality & suppleness to dry, oily, combination & sun-damaged skin. Our remarkable, certified organic rosehip seed oil comes from the Chilean Andes. Known as rosa rubiginosa or rosa mosqueta, this silky oil of the rose hip seed has been used for centuries by the indigenous people of the Chilean Andes to treat burned, sun-damaged or scarred skin. Rosehip seed oil is rich in the naturally occurring pro-vitamin A and vitamin C. It has considerable amounts of polyunsaturated essential fatty acids (EFA) containing 80% gamma linolenic acid and linoleic acid. As a result it significantly regenerates and strengthens cell membranes aiding in the prevention of early signs of aging. With daily use, Rosehip Treatment Facial Serum works to minimize and soften the appearance of scars, and smooth fine lines and wrinkles. It also soothes dry, sunburned and sun-damaged skin. This Serum helps to balance excessively oily or dry skin, minimize the appearance of large pores, and purify impure skin prone to pimples. Used on a consistent basis, your skin will look smoother, fresher and more supple. Precious essential oils of rose geranium, sandalwood, rose otto & carrot seed are added to enhance the action of the rosehip seed oil. Their tiny molecular size and lipophilic (oil-loving) tendency make them ideal for curative skin treatments. Ingredients: Rosehip Seed (Rosa canina) Fruit Oil*, Jojoba (Simmondsia chinensis) Seed Oil*, Rose Geranium (Pelargonium graveolens) Oil*, Carrot (Daucus carota) Seed Essential Oil*, Hawaiian Sandalwood (Santalum paniculatum) Wood Oil*, Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Flower Oil*, Rose Otto (Rosa damascena) Flower Oil*, Vitamin E (Tocopherol) *ORGANIC How to use: Use oil serum & HydroSoul together. Mist face with 5-10 sprays of hydrosol. In palms of hands, mix dime-sized amount of oil serum with 5-10 more sprays of hydrosol. Gently press mixture onto skin evenly distributing between cheeks, forehead & chin. Finish with a misting of hydrosol. For drier skin, follow with one of our occlusive moisturizers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: What makes Everist different? Everything. Most shampoos are more than 70% water. We left the water out and packed in potent plant-based moisturizers, creating a hybrid of haircare and skincare. Our patent-pending HydraSoft Tech uses glycerin, one of nature's most powerful humectants, to leave hair softer, silkier and more resilient, with a soothed, hydrated scalp and results that compound over time. Each 3.4 fl oz (100 ml) tube or tin is 3x concentrated with over 30% glycerin, over 15% aloe vera, rosemary and peppermint oils, and patented all-natural bond repair. Its energizing herbal-citrus scent comes from our signature essential oil blend of orange, bergamot, rosemary, clary sage and peppermint. How to use: Thoroughly wet hair and hands. For mid-length hair, dispense a 1 inch strip from the tube (roll the included tube key down) or scoop a large marble-sized amount from the tin. Smoosh between wet hands to activate, then work from root to tip for at least 30 seconds to build a rich, creamy lather. Rinse well. Pro tip: for extra lather, try a double cleanse starting with a half-inch micro-dose. 25X award-winning, including TIME's Best Inventions, Fast Company's World Changing Ideas and the Cosmopolitan Holy Grail Beauty Award. Dermatologist-tested, hypoallergenic, pH-balanced and rated Excellent on Yuka. A third-party assessment by Bluebird Climate found a 77% smaller carbon impact and 62% smaller waste impact than water-filled shampoo in a plastic bottle. Pair with Everist Deep Conditioning Concentrate.

Each of the 24 bamboo thong panty liners are ultra-thin and individually wrapped in compostable, plant-based wrappers, perfect for absorbing your flow on-the-go. We're a business founded by two women-of-colour for people who menstruate, that's why every pack back gives back with 5% of profits going to people + planet. Vegan, cruelty-free, Carbon Neutral and BCorp Certified. We've got your back (and your front) with shamelessly natural care for life's messiest moments.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Super Absorbent: Our Liners, Pads, and Tampons are all super absorbent, leak-proof protection for your flow. Super Soft: Our pads + Liners use silky bamboo viscose made with organic bamboo. Flo Tampons are made with cloud-soft organic cotton. Period pants made with sustainably sourced cotton. Sensitive Skin Friendly: Designed with delicate skin in mind and made without chlorine bleach, artificial dyes, or fragrances. Tampons made without synthetic fibres. No irritation. No drama. Low Impact Packaging: All our products come in recyclable paper boxes, and our pads, liners, and tampons are wrapped in compostable, plant-based, biofilm. Susan & Tara met on their first day of their master's program at LSE and fell into an instant best friendship. The idea for the business started on a classic BFF bathroom trip between lectures. Susan wanted to start a Fempire to take on the toxic patriarchy bros, while Tara couldn't find organic tampons anywhere in the UK. Susan was like, 'Organic tampons? Why do you even need those? A long chat about the impact of synthetic fibers and harsh chemicals, many late nights, and a master's dissertation later, and Here We Flo was born. We are a proudly female owned and led, B-CORP business on a mission to empower people with periods to feel crazy confident even when it’s messy. At Here We Flo, we treat period care as personal care, not sanitary hygiene. Because your vagina deserves better. We create “better for you” accessible upgrades for period, pee, and pleasure that are better for vaginas + vulvas. Using materials that you can trust to work. No drama. No bad vibes. Just premium vulva experiences. Crazy confidence is all about how you feel inside. So we fight shame and stigma around periods, pee, and pleasure with a funny, feminist, + fierce personality and empower our community with actually useful information. We’re also committed to giving 5% of profits back to people + planet. Welcome to the Fempire, bestie.

Situated on the Mid-North coast of NSW, Freshwater Farm is our family owned and operated property producing a variety of distilled essential oils, from our farm to your skin. Everyday Luxury: The delicious aroma of Rosewater triple milled with Australian Pink Clay and skin softening emollients creates a creamy lather rich in moisture. Perfect for daily use and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Follow the journey (at)freshwaterfarm_aus as we continue to add aromatic and functional botanicals to our plantation for the benefit of your skin. Not tested on animals. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: California Olive Ranch’s globally inspired, Destination Series is a celebration of high quality high-quality extra virgin olive oil produced around the world. The olives are proudly grown and harvested by our partner growers in Argentina, Chile, Portugal, and our California farmers, and are expertly blended in California to create the ideal taste profile. This Olive Oil is made from cold-pressing olives to extract their natural oils. Other “light” or “pure” olive oil is made using excessive heat or chemicals which alter the taste and quality of the olive oil. We never use high heat or solvents in our EVOO, ensuring you get gourmet-quality. This gourmet EVOO features well-rounded tasty notes of fresh herbs, fruit and green grass. Home chefs like you use it for marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether it is for a sweet or savory dish. Using olive oil as a part of your daily diet may promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. As an added bonus, our extra virgin olive oils are verified non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project, and certified kosher by Orthodox Union. They are also Whole30 approved, certified paleo, keto verified, and vegan friendly. All oils at California Olive Ranch are certified "Extra Virgin" by Applied Sensory, passing both rigid chemical and sensory evaluations. Our delicious olive oil is the only oil you need in your kitchen.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: A truly unscented tea light that sets a calm, steady glow without soot, smoke, or a scent that fights your food, your essential oils, or a quiet moment. If you have been let down by candles that promise neutral and still smell like chemicals, these are different. The reason is the wax. Many households switched to palm wax after looking for a cleaner-burning alternative to paraffin and soy. GoodLight is made from 100% non-GMO palm wax, not petroleum-derived paraffin, so it burns clean with no soot and no smoke. There is no added fragrance, no phthalates, and no chemicals, just a plain, honest flame. The burn matters as much as the wax. A filament-free cotton wick stays lit, giving a steady, even burn that relights to the bottom of the cup with no tunneling and no waste. Each candle burns up to 4+ clean hours, and for the longest, most even burn, use one continuous cycle rather than relighting several times. These long lasting tea lights candles hold their own on a dinner table or under a wax warmer. Because they are unscented, these palm-wax tea lights fit standard essential-oil diffusers and wax and tart warmers without ever competing with your oils. They sit in standard tea-light holders for everyday indoor home ambiance, and their neutral flame suits Shabbat, prayer, and altar tables. Crafters reach for them as a gentle heat source for wax-seal stamping. As a clean-burning cross-shopper pick for soy tealight candles buyers, they deliver the neutral burn without the soy. This 400 count case is the bulk pack: enough white tea lights for weddings, hosting, and fragrance-free dinner settings, so you are never caught short. Every cup is recyclable aluminum, every box is recyclable paperboard printed with vegetable-based inks, and every purchase supports the sustainable palm oil movement. A clean, honest choice for your home. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Rethink your toothpaste. Huppy Toothpaste Tablets are the plastic-free, fluoride-free alternative that actually works. Voted best toothpaste tablets by Women's Health and Healthline, and trusted by 500,000+ customers who have made the switch from traditional toothpaste tubes. Why hydroxyapatite? Hydroxyapatite (HA) is the same mineral that makes up 97% of tooth enamel. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Protein packed Skyr (“skeer”) has been a provision of Icelanders since the days of the Vikings, and it’s still enjoyed by Icelanders of all ages to this day. Icelandic Provisions uses the same heirloom skyr cultures that Icelanders have passed down for generations. Fresh whole milk from family farms gives Krímí Skyr a rich, creamy texture. We add cold brew from Te and Kaffi, a family-owned coffee roastery in Iceland. Give your taste buds a wake-up call. Whether it’s your breakfast go-to or an afternoon treat, Krímí Skyr is a richer, creamier way to bring a little joy to your everyday.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The formula for this bar of shampoo was discovered on a handwritten recipe card, loosely placed in an old New England Cookbook many years ago by J.R. Made without synthetic oils, chemicals, or detergents; sulfate-free, GMO-free, and never tested on animals. Handcrafted in small batches in Cornish, New Hampshire on a 95% solar-powered farm. No plastic bottles, no synthetic fragrances, no animal products.

One of our closest producer relationships, the Guarnizo Family operates six farms in Huila, Colombia. Simply add 8-10 oz of hot or cold water to enjoy."

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: This soothing herbal infusion combines organic chamomile and organic lemongrass to create a delicate, floral flavor with a hint of citrus. Each cup is naturally caffeine-free, making it the perfect bedtime ritual or moment of peace during your day. Relax and unwind with a cup of Sunset Chamomile. Delicate chamomile blossoms and fresh lemongrass offer a smooth sip with notes of honey and soft citrus. This tea is a partnership with the Kenyan Women's Tea Co-op! All herbs are hand-picked and produced without massive machinery, slowing down the processing and allowing you to taste the high-quality of hand-crafted tea. These teas come direct from the farmer, there are no middleman stops along the journey, meaning you get a fresher cup of tea and the farmer receives a fair-wage. We keep it simple and pure. No added flavors, no sugar, no fillers — just whole, organic herbs. Every tea bag is plastic-free, unbleached, and fully compostable. 100% FRESH INGREDIENTS: Organic Chamomile, Organic Lemongrass (Gluten/Sugar-Free and Caffeine-Free).
