whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Discover the secret to creating authentic Neapolitan-style pizza at home with King Arthur 00 Pizza Flour. This premium flour is the key to achieving the perfect balance of crispy and chewy crust that defines true Italian pizza. Milled to exacting '00' standards from a proprietary blend of hard and soft 100% American-grown wheat, our flour is incredibly fine, allowing you to replicate the quintessential leopard spots characteristic of authentic Neapolitan pizzas, even in your home oven. The 3 lb resealable bag ensures freshness and convenience for multiple baking sessions. While primarily designed for pizza, this versatile flour also excels in pasta making and other Italian-inspired recipes, making it a must-have for any home baker looking to elevate their culinary creations. King Arthur 00 Pizza Flour is Non-GMO Project Verified, reflecting our commitment to quality and purity. As a 100% Employee-Owned Company and a founding B Corporation, King Arthur has been a trusted name in baking since 1790, offering top-quality products and inspiring recipes. To create the perfect Neapolitan-style pizza, aim for a thinner crust in the middle with a slightly puffed rim for that essential crunch. Top with tomato sauce, fresh mOzzarella, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil for a classic margherita that will transport you straight to Naples. Baking tips: For best results, use a pizza stone or steel preheated in a very hot oven (as high as your oven will go, ideally 500°F or higher). Allow the dough to rest and rise properly for optimal texture and flavor. Remember, practice makes perfect when it comes to stretching and shaping your dough. With King Arthur 00 Pizza Flour, you're not just making pizza; you're crafting an authentic Italian experience in your own kitchen. Elevate your homemade pizzas and impress your family and friends with restaurant-quality results. Start your journey to pizza perfection today!

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: THE HEADBAND | This twist headband for men is a top seller and for good reason. For starters, it's made from ridiculously soft, sweat-wicking and breathable organic cotton. A warning: once you go organic, you'll never be able to wear a synthetic (read: plastic) headband again. Second, it works. We designed the sweatband with a twist that sits at the nape of the neck, keeping the headband from slipping during even the sweatiest workout. This design, coupled with the sweat-wicking organic cotton, means no more headband slipping during your workouts. Third, it's versatile. Choose to wear the headband thin like a tennis headband, scrunched for a rocker-headband or opened wide for a full bandana head covering, Last but not least, it's ethically made. Read more about this last point in the "About KOOSHOO" section below. MATERIALS | The body of this twist headwrap is made from 93% organic cotton and 7% spandex. CARE | For longest life, wash the headband cold and lay flat to dry. The headband is color stable and will also be fine in the dryer. ABOUT KOOSHOO | KOOSHOO is an eco-friendly clothing and accessories brand created by husband and wife yoga teachers to help others feel good (KOOSHOO literally means "feeling good"). We make organic headbands, the world's ONLY plastic-free hairties, stylish shawls and baby plants that grow with a child. We always use the finest organic and natural materials, ethically manufacture in certified facilities, dye using low-impact azo-free dyes and package in 100% recycled and/or biodegradable packaging. We're a small business run by real people that care deeply about our customers, suppliers and the environment. We stand 100% behind our products (full refunds and/or exchanges if not stoked) and every time a sale is made, the team does a happy dance in honor of the customer.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Lumineux is the first truly ethical oral care company to emerge on the market in close to a century. Founded on decades of international research conducted by two world-renowned dentists, our products have a back-to-basics approach that use naturally occurring ingredients like Dead Sea salt, aloe vera juice and potent essential oils to handle the source of bad breath, decay and disease without cumulative side-effects, and unnecessary additives. Lumineux is the first oral care product to protect the oral micro biome and neutralize the toxins of bad bacteria, rather than indiscriminately killing bacteria. The result is a clean, non-toxic, and proven effective line of solutions that are backed by clinical and in-the-field studies that are truly head and shoulders above what’s available to consumers. Dr. Kourosh Maddahi, Lumineux’s Founder and CEO, puts it perfectly, saying, “You shouldn’t have to choose between a product that’s good for you, and a product that actually works.” Lumineux remains the only oral care line to carry the Made Safe certification, as well as Non- Toxic certification for all its products from the LEMI Lab in France, and head-to-head clinical studies against every leading brand from the University of Irvine, California.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Methyl Folate ((6S)-5-methyltetrahydrofolic acid or (6S)-5-MTHF) is the most biologically active form of folic acid. Quatrefolic is the 4th generation development in folate delivery. With certain inherited errors in metabolism and under a variety of physiologic stresses, the transformation of folic acid into the active form of folate either does not properly take place or is inadequate. Unlike folic acid, 5-MTHF can cross the blood-brain barrier. HEALTH CLAIM: Healthful diets with adequate folic acid may reduce a woman's risk of having a child with certain brain or spinal cord defects.

With 19 cutting-edge actives, this synergistic formula brings dramatically brighter, healthier, smoother looking skin in just one jar! Chaga - A natural adaptogen packed with powerful antioxidants including superoxide dismutase and zinc. Works to rejuvenate and protect the skin from daily stressors and exposure to pollutants. Shea Butter - Used in Africa for centuries for its moisturizing & soothing properties, shea butter is a rich source of the powerful antioxidants vitamin A & E, crucial fatty acids and cinnamic acid. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: What's the secret to making exceptional foods? Using exceptional ingredients! Morton Gothelf, the founder of Morton & Bassett Spices, had always been a great cook and always seemed to be entertaining friends. He was passionate about finding just the right ingredients to create the perfect combination of flavors. In searching for superior ingredients, he found that the best quality spices were difficult to obtain in a typical grocery or gourmet store. Morton began to find sources for the best spices and then started Morton & Bassett Spices in 1986, hoping to fill this niche. The combination of great ingredients, good value and clear bottles that showcased the product was a hit. Since 1986 the business has grown quickly thanks to the growing numbers of loyal Morton & Bassett customers. Once a good cook tries Morton & Bassett they inevitably become loyal fans. Today there are over 100 world class spices in the product line and more flavors are in the works.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience the gentle revolution in hair color with Naturcolor’s innovative botanical-based formula. Unlike conventional dyes that strip hair with harsh chemicals and deposit monotone dye, our unique approach uses just enough chemistry to enable Naturcolor’s fine Italian pigments to adhere to each strand, preserving hair's natural variation while effectively covering gray. The result? Rich, multi-dimensional color that looks authentically yours with significantly less risk of irritation or damage. Our nourishing botanical blend actually improves shine, strength, and overall health with every application. Naturcolor fits easily into your life with a refreshingly pleasant experience that minimizes harsh odors and mess. What was once a necessary chore becomes a moment of intentional self-care, leaving you with healthy, vibrant hair that helps you feel ready for whatever comes your way. With Naturcolor, you never need to choose between beautiful, lustrous locks and your personal well-being. Crafted in small batches in California since 1992, Naturcolor is not just for women. Thousands of men have discreetly colored their hair with it at home. And the gentler formula is great for coloring facial hair without irritation or staining. Naturcolor comes in 31 colors that can be blended to create your own unique shade. A complete application takes less than an hour and one box can be used for multiple root touch-ups. Note: Final results will vary based on original hair color. Hair that is much lighter than your selected Naturcolor shade will appear lighter after coloring, while hair closer to the Naturcolor shade will take on a deeper, more intense color. This variability also applies to gray hair, which will take color differently than darker strands, contributing to the dimensional results that make Naturcolor look natural and never “dyed”.

Chai, the word for tea in Swahili, is integral to the cultural and social fabric of many civilizations. That is our inspiration.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Elevate your home cooking with our Organic Mushroom Dashi, a rich, plant-based foundation inspired by the traditions of Japanese cuisine. Just as a Western chef reaches for a flavorful vegetable stock, Japanese cooks rely on dashi to create depth, balance, and savory complexity in countless dishes. Whether you're building a comforting bowl of miso soup, preparing a hearty hot pot, or adding umami richness to everyday recipes, this ready-to-use broth saves you hours of prep time while delivering authentic flavor. Simply shake well, pour, and bring restaurant-quality taste to your kitchen. Crafted with organic mushrooms and nourishing kelp, this vegan dashi delivers a deep, earthy umami character with layers of savory flavor that powder concentrates simply can't match. The combination creates a smooth, well-rounded broth that enhances everything from traditional Japanese dishes to modern plant-based cooking, making it an indispensable pantry staple for home chefs and culinary enthusiasts alike.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Elevate your home cooking with our traditional liquid Dashi, the essential foundation of authentic Japanese cuisine. Just as a Western chef reaches for chicken or vegetable stock, a Japanese kitchen relies on dashi. Whether you are deglazing a pan for a fusion stir-fry or preparing a traditional shabu-shabu, this ready-to-use base saves you hours of prep time without sacrificing quality. Simply shake well, pour, and watch as your kitchen transforms into a professional Japanese bistro. Crafted with a blend of premium katsuobushi (dried skipjack, bullet, and frigate tuna) and nourishing kelp, this broth delivers a complex, smoky umami depth that powder concentrates simply can’t match. Finishing with tamari soy sauce, we’ve ensured a richer, smoother savory profile that perfectly complements everything from classic miso soup to simmered stews and vibrant hot pots.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Nutiva Organic Liquid Coconut Oil is rich in MCTs, making it a nourishing and versatile great food for cooking, baking, and beauty. Unlike other oils on the market, Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil is never processed using hexane or other dangerous chemicals. At Nutiva, we start with organic, non-GMO Southeast Asian coconuts, sustainably harvested and immediately cold pressed to naturally extract the fresh, flavorful coconut oil. Next, Nutiva uses a USDA certified organic process to extract the fats from the virgin coconut oil that remain solid at room temperature, resulting in an oil that remains liquid, even at cooler temperatures. The neutral flavor makes it great for sautéing, baking, or enhancing your favorite recipes. It's ideal as a medium-heat cooking oil, a nutritious substitute in baking and is an excellent alternative to olive oil. It’s also a wholesome addition to vegetarian, vegan, raw, whole food, paleo-friendly, ketogenic, and gluten-free diets. The purity and nutrient density of Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil make it good for you both inside and out. Use the luscious, soothing oil as a natural skin moisturizer, eye make-up remover, deep conditioning hair treatment, or combine it with Nutiva Coconut Sugar and your favorite essential oil for an exfoliating, refreshing body scrub. Nutiva was founded in 1999 with a single purpose in mind - to Revolutionize the Way the World Eats. We produce organic, nutrient-dense foods that are good for you and good for the planet. Social and environmental responsibility is a core part of Nutiva’s culture and business. We are dedicated to sourcing organic products, obtaining fair trade certification, greening our facilities and operations, and funding tree planting at schools in our local community; we are constantly seeking ways to better protect our environment and ensure a better quality of life for employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. Please Note: Refrigerate upon arrival. FDA Disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Slippery Elm Bark, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. Please Note: Refrigerate upon arrival. FDA Disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Morton Gothelf, the founder of Morton & Bassett Spices, had always been a great cook and always seemed to be entertaining friends. In searching for superior ingredients, he found that the best quality spices were difficult to obtain in a typical grocery or gourmet store. Morton began to find sources for the best spices and then started Morton & Bassett Spices in 1986, hoping to fill this niche. The combination of great ingredients, good value and clear bottles that showcased the product was a hit. Since 1986 the business has grown quickly thanks to the growing numbers of loyal Morton & Bassett customers. Once a good cook tries Morton & Bassett they inevitably become loyal fans. MADE WITH GROUND CLOVES: To make this liquid herbal extract, we use ground cloves – the cloves are milled just before the menstruum is added. Adults: Take 1 serving (20 drops) in 2 oz of water or juice, 2-4x per day between meals. Herb Pharm is the nation’s #1 herbal tincture brand.‡ Our liquid extracts are powerfully effective, delivering broad-spectrum activity, and highly digestible, working swiftly and efficiently. We grow more than 75 herbs on our Regenerative Organic Certified® farms and ethically source other herbs from our network of trusted wildcrafters, growers, and brokers. We proudly manufacture our liquid herbal extracts, using clean processing methods without the use of synthetic chemicals, in the beautiful southern Oregon countryside. We assure the identity of our herbs through macroscopic and organoleptic analysis, as well as HPTLC fingerprinting. ‡SPINS Natural Channel, Total US, 52 WE 11/2/2025 *These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. Organically grown cotton has less of an environmental impact than conventional cotton but it costs more to produce, so your decision is a direct investment in the future of our planet.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Organic Valley Organic Ghee Clarified Butter is versatile, with a rich, nutty flavor. This organic clarified butter is lactose free and casein free. With a high smoke point, ghee is a great cooking butter over high heat, including sautéing, frying, roasting and baking. Substitute ghee for oil or organic butter in your favorite recipes, spread it on bread, drizzle it over popcorn, or try adding it to your morning coffee. We slowly simmer our ghee butter to coax the excess water out while preserving the nutritional benefits of pasture raised butter. In the process, some of the ghee’s milk solids caramelize, leaving behind hints of sweetness and roasted nuts. Organic Valley ghee comes in a resealable, shelf stable container for easy storage.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Dave’s Killer Bread® Limited Edition Pumpkin Spice Madness Bagels bring a bold, cozy autumn twist to your everyday breakfast routine. This isn’t your everyday pumpkin spice—it’s organic Pumpkin Spice Madness, turned up loud, bold, and wildly unapologetic. Infused with warm pumpkin spice flavor featuring organic cinnamon, brown sugar and pumpkin, and hearty whole grain nutrition, these soft, satisfying pumpkin spice bagels deliver a crave‑worthy balance of subtly sweet spice and signature Dave’s texture in every bite. 13g whole grains,10g protein, and 4g fiber per bagel. Our organic pumpkin spice bagels help keep you fueled and satisfied all morning long. Made with organic ingredients and pumpkin spice, these pumpkin spice bagels offer feel‑good nutrition without sacrificing flavor. USDA organic and Non‑GMO Project Verified, Pumpkin Spice Madness Bagels are crafted with the quality you expect from Dave’s Killer Bread®—no bleached flour, no high fructose corn syrup, and no artificial preservatives or artificial ingredients. Just clean, organic ingredients you can trust. The story of Dave’s Killer Bread® began at the Portland Farmers Market, when Dave Dahl and his nephew brought some loaves of Dave's bread to sell. For Dave, this marked the beginning of a new chapter in his life. Though he grew up in a family of bakers, his life took a different path. A path that landed him in prison for 15 years. Determined to prove his worth and make a positive impact, Dave worked tirelessly to bake breads that tasted unlike anything else on the market — packed with seeds and grains, made with only the very best organic and Non-GMO Project Verified ingredients. Dave’s Killer Bread® believes everyone is capable of greatness. One in three of the company's employee partners at their Milwaukie, OR bakery has a criminal background—but your past doesn't define your future. As a proud Second Chance Employer, Dave’s Killer Bread® truly believes everyone deserves a second chance to become a Good Seed.

Morton Gothelf, the founder of Morton & Bassett Spices, had always been a great cook and always seemed to be entertaining friends. In searching for superior ingredients, he found that the best quality spices were difficult to obtain in a typical grocery or gourmet store. Use it as an ingredient in recipes like Garlic and Herb White Bean Dip, or substitute it for roux or bechamel as a sauce starter. Pacific Foods canned soup is an elevated pantry staple and a must-have for creating something quick and easy. Made with non-GMO ingredients, our USDA-certified organic soup contains no added sugars or artificial flavors. It’s also a gluten free soup that can be enjoyed on its own, customized with your favorite toppings, or paired with a salad. Simply mix the condensed soup with 1 can of milk and microwave on high for 2.5 to 3 minutes in a covered microwave-safe bowl, or heat in a saucepan on the stove, stirring occasionally. Each 10.5 oz recyclable can contains about 2.5 servings of microwave soup. In addition to Cream of Roasted Garlic and Herb, Pacific Foods offers Cream of Mushroom, Cream of Chicken, and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

Regenerative Organic Certified ingredients like the tomato paste in this canned soup build upon USDA Organic standards with an extra focus on soil health, land management, and farmer and worker fairness. Free from high fructose corn syrup, artificial flavors, and artificial colors, this gluten free and vegan soup makes it easy to be intentional about the way you stock your pantry. Savor a warm bowl of organic tomato soup on its own, topped with fresh basil, or paired with a grilled cheese sandwich. You can also use it as an ingredient in recipes like casseroles, sauces, and hearty chilis and stews, elevating every bite with rich, organic flavor. To prepare, simply mix the condensed soup with 1 can of water and microwave on high for 2.5 to 3 minutes, or heat in a saucepan on the stove, stirring occasionally. Each 10.75 oz recyclable can contains about 2.5 servings of microwave soup.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience layers of nourishing flavor with Pacific Foods Organic Chicken Bone Broth With Ginger, Turmeric, and Black Pepper. We slow-simmer organic chicken bones with vegetables, ginger, turmeric, and black pepper for a savory bone broth that’s full of naturally occurring collagen and has a subtle kick. Sip a cup of warm chicken bone broth instead of coffee or tea for a delicious, satisfying addition to your everyday routine. It's great for refueling after workouts, beating the afternoon slump, or relaxing in the evening. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, add a slice of lemon, ginger or some fresh herbs. Our USDA-certified organic bone broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free of gluten. It may also be suitable for paleo and keto diets. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Chicken Bone Broth contains 8 grams of protein, 1 gram of carbs and 40 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains roughly 4 servings. In addition to drinking it as a traditional sipping broth, you can use this bone broth in any recipe that calls for chicken broth, chicken stock or water. Try it as a soup base, to enhance sauces, or to cook veggies.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: ★Partners Coffee: A fresh morning start★Our flagship espresso at our original Williamsburg shop and roastery. Bedford is comprised of two of our oldest sourcing relationships, the coffees from which merge together to create an incredibly delicious and complex experience. Look for ripe stone fruits, citrus brightness, and a beautifully syrupy body. Amazing on its own as an espresso or try in a cortado.We got our start in 2012 by roasting incredible coffee, sourced from sustainable relationships with producers around the world, out of our Williamsburg, Brooklyn cafe & roastery. Since then we've been working hard to expand the Partners experience across a product line-up that features things like cold brew cans, subscriptions, and rotating single-origin coffees. We can't wait to see what the future holds, though we believe it'll be great because of friends like you. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: “On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It’s visceral." Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee. Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Some have described Alfred Peet as the “big bang” of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America’s expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet’s pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason’s one-of-a-kind taste, you’ll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason’s but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It’s the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Great coffee brings friends and neighbors together like nothing else. That's why we created this medium roast to pay tribute to the time-honored pastime of lingering in the café, casually sipping an expertly brewed cup over conversation. The three Latin American coffees in this carefully crafted blend were selected for their balance and brightness, and the roast fine-tuned to brew the perfect medium-bodied cup. We decided to name it after our third café, opened by Alfred Peet in 1980 on Domingo Avenue in Berkeley, in the shadow of the Claremont Hotel. For more than three decades, Peet's regulars have gathered here to enjoy hand-crafted drinks and the camaraderie they inspire. And that's something worth commemorating. Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Colombia Dark Roast Coffee is for those seeking exceptional, full-bodied Colombian coffee, shining and sweet from the rarest lots. Colombia is synonymous with good coffee, and the country produces more washed Arabica beans than any other. But while the overall quality is consistent and familiar to the American palate, Colombia also produces exceptional coffees from specific micro-climates. Not one but three cordilleras traverse this enormous, emerald country and the variety of sun and rain regimes mean that harvesting is going on somewhere almost throughout the year. As always, we select by the cup, seeking the rarest lots of the brightest, sweetest, most exceptional beans. Our favorite, flavorful, full-bodied Colombian coffee comes from the heights of the remote southern province of Huila, a region that still grows the traditional typica beans along with the newer varieties. At the massif of two ranges, and the headwaters of a river that flows 950 miles north to the Caribbean, a small group of growers produce a shining, sweet and delicately fruited Colombia that has a taste unto its own.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Ever since Alfred Peet opened the doors of his first small Berkeley shop in 1966, Peet's has been known as a pioneer of fine, distinctive coffees high-grown, higher quality, and deeply roasted to maximize flavor. Peet's House Blend Dark Roast Coffee is a perfect introduction to our signature style. First crafted by Mr. Peet, this blend of carefully selected, choice beans from our favorite Latin American origins brews a cup that's uniquely rich and approachable, with a pleasant spiciness. It's deep-roasted by hand in small batches to impart the most flavor and aroma. And like all our coffees, it's delivered unimaginably fresh. Bright, balanced flavors and medium body make House Blend inviting and easy to love. Mr. Peet used to call it a "starter coffee, recommending it to new customers as their "intro" to the Peet's style. And more than five decades later, Peetniks everywhere are still at home with House.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Organic French Roast encompasses our favorite beans for this deepest roast. These beans are from the leading Latin American origins, such as Guatemala and Colombia, where high altitudes enable coffee cherry to mature more slowly, becoming denser, harder, and packed with flavor. These inherently bright, juicy beans retain their bold complexity under the heat of a deep roast. To grow organic coffee is a commitment to environmental stewardship despite an inevitably smaller yield. Where conventional farming benefits from carefully formulated nutrients, organic farming is local and labor intensive, with resources like natural compost, fashioned on the farm. It's more work to produce less coffee and we're happy to support the extra effort. Enjoy this meticulously grown, deep-roasted coffee that is a bold dedication to flavor, farm, and future.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: In Colombia, luminosa means "shining or bright". Peet's Luminosa Breakfast Blend Light Roast Coffee layers subtle sweetness from Colombia with just the right touch of Ethiopia floral aromatics, a pair we knew would go perfectly together. We started with a coffee from the Huila region in Colombia's highlands, a place where beans are cultivated over 4,500 feet and known for their smooth, sweet character. Then to Ethiopia, coffee's birthplace, where unique varieties yield exquisite coffees with delicate aromas. Formerly known as Colombia Luminosa, we approached this bright blend, our first light roast, as we do all our coffees: carefully select the very best beans, then hand roast them in small batches to achieve their utmost flavor.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Big Bang Medium Roast Coffee is our signature medium roast created to celebrate Alfred Peet and our 50th anniversary. Some have described Alfred Peet as the "big bang" of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America's expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet's pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason's one-of-a-kind taste, you'll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason's but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It's the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Perfect Bar Protein + Prebiotics Chocolate Mint Crunch delivers 20 g of protein without compromising on taste or ingredients. Experience a satisfying, soft and crispy texture, bursting with flavors of refreshing cool mint, rich dark chocolate, and freshly ground peanut butter in every protein bar. Made with grass-fed whey protein, helping you meet daily protein goals at home, at the office, at the gym, or on the go. In addition to protein, this chocolate peanut butter bar provides 6 g of fiber, which may help support healthy digestion. It also includes 3 g of prebiotic fiber. Packed with 20+ superfoods and sweetened with organic honey, Chocolate Mint Crunch is made with clean ingredients and contains no artificial flavors, colors, preservatives, or sugar alcohols. It is also gluten free, non-GMO, Kosher, and has a low glycemic index. Kept refrigerated for freshness, these protein bars are convenient for breakfast on the go, a balanced snack, or kept in your gym bag for active adults, busy professionals, and students. Enjoy this bar on its own or pair it with coffee in the morning, fruit at snack time, or your usual gym bag routine after training. These bars can be enjoyed out of the fridge for up to 7 days and can be re-refrigerated if not consumed, making them practical for commuting, travel days, lunch breaks, office fridges, campus days, and outdoor activities like hiking or field days. This 7-count pack offers a convenient way to keep a protein snack ready when you need it, whether stocked in the office fridge, packed for class, or carried along for a busy day.

Combined with the soothing and humectant properties of honey, this balm works to lock in moisture and leave skin feeling soft, supple, and well-conditioned. Whether you use it on your hands, lips, elbows, or other dry areas, Phil's Tallow + Honey Balm delivers a luxurious, wholesome experience. Its thick, salve-like consistency means a little goes a long way, making it a practical addition to your daily skincare routine. Ideal for those who prefer simple, straightforward ingredients in their personal care products, this balm is a versatile staple worth keeping on hand.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our original name, La Crema Viñera, means “best of the vine,” setting the standard for all we do since 1979. For more than 40 years, our family-owned and operated winery has focused exclusively on cool-climate appellations, from our original home in the Russian River Valley, to Monterey and now the Willamette Valley. We’re continually exploring these very special regions—passionate in our belief that they make uniquely expressive and elegant wines. We select vineyards that fall within cool mesoclimates and possess well-drained soils, which naturally restricts yields and produces distinctive, balanced wines. Our grapes ripen slowly and see long hang time, allowing complex flavors and aromas and firm acid structure to develop. Our vineyard site selection and boutique winemaking techniques ensure the consistently distinct, naturally balance wines we are committed to producing. In the summer of 2016, La Crema settled into a new home, nestled within the storied Saralee’s Vineyard in the heart of the Russian River Valley. Here, we’ve created a premier destination for unparalleled wine education and culinary explorations. Planted in 1988 by Saralee Kunde and her husband Richard, Saralee’s Vineyard was carefully tended by the couple and has a reputation for producing some of the finest grapes in California. The cool climate, varied terrain and diverse soils provide an ideal environment for a wide range of varietals, particularly Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. Built in the late 1800s, an historic building sits atop a knoll on the sprawling property, overlooking rolling vineyards. Originally a barn, the Kunde’s transformed the building into their family home, and now the story continues as the striking structure begins its third phase as a tasting room and winery destination for La Crema. Revered by the community for her agricultural advocacy and contributions to local organizations, including strong support of Sonoma’s 4-H Center and Future Farmers of America, Saralee Kunde built a legacy that we are honored to carry on.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.raw_name: Pinot Noir Monterey, 750mL

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The Clark & Telephone Vineyard was established in 1972 and planted with “own root” Martini clone vines. Located just 13 miles from the ocean and situated on a west-facing slope, this vineyard experiences weather patterns that pull from west to east to bring cool fog and coastal breezes inland until August when Santa Ana winds begin. This climate makes for later-ripening and longer-hanging grapes with a delightful fruitiness, great acidity and underlying flavor nuances that contribute additional complexity. Due to intensive pruning and crop-thinning, the vines produce loose clusters with small, intensely flavored berries. The result is dense, dark-berry fruit and abundant, sweet, baking-spice characteristics that are synonymous with the Martini clone.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: PLANT STRONG Organic Firehouse Chili delivers bold, hearty comfort food made with simple organic ingredients and powerful plant-based nutrition. This ready-to-eat vegan chili features a satisfying blend of organic navy beans, black beans, red kidney beans, tomatoes, corn, peppers, and smoky spices for rich flavor with a mildly spicy finish. Each 14.5 oz carton provides 20g of plant-based protein and 10g of fiber, making it a filling and nourishing option for lunch, dinner, post-workout meals, or quick pantry-friendly convenience. PLANTSTRONG Firehouse Chili is USDA Organic, Non-GMO, contains zero added sugar, and is made without seed oils. Designed for busy lifestyles, this shelf-stable plant-based chili heats quickly in minutes on the stovetop or in the microwave. Enjoy it straight from the bowl or customize it with toppings like avocado, salsa, cilantro, lime, or hot sauce. It also pairs perfectly with rice, baked potatoes, greens, pasta, or tortilla chips. Whether you are looking for a wholesome vegan chili, a high-protein pantry staple, or a flavorful plant-based comfort meal, PLANT STRONG Organic Firehouse Chili brings hearty flavor and clean ingredients together in every carton.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Raeburn is an Olde English term which means "the river where one goes to drink." So, it's fitting that Raeburn's expressive, beautifully balanced wines begin in the heart of the Russian River Valley where some of the world's finest Burgundy grapes are grown. The Russian River Valley opens to the Pacific Ocean allowing cool fog and breezes to flow directly into the vineyards. Chardonnay and Pinot Noir grapes benefit greatly from this maritime influence which fosters a longer more temperate growing season and yields fill flavored, complex wines with well-balanced acidity. The Russian River Valley appellation lies at the geographical heart of Sonoma County; this is where some of wine country's best known and most beloved varietals really earned their reputation, setting the standard for California Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, while remaining home to sought-after old vine Zinfandel.

Rao’s Homemade Sauce is a premium, carb conscious pasta sauce made with only the finest ingredients. Delicious speaks for itself when enjoying this tomato sauce. Our formula is designed for fast absorption to help you fall asleep quickly, without next-day grogginess. It’s a great choice for those adjusting to time zone changes, managing shift work, or looking for a nightly wind-down ritual that’s effective yet gentle. Ideal for adults who want a natural sleep aid without the use of sedatives or habit-forming ingredients. This melatonin supplement is made with non-GMO, gluten-free, and vegan-friendly ingredients—free from artificial colors, preservatives, or common allergens. It’s a clean, science-backed sleep solution you can trust, night after night.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Ruffino Riserva Ducale Chianti Classico Red Wine is an iconic red wine blend named in tribute to the Duke of Aosta, who made Ruffino wine the royal supplier. This full-bodied Chianti wine opens with an elegant bouquet of violets, cherries, wild berries, and plums, followed by tobacco, clove, and eucalyptus nuances. The structure is bold, and the palate is balanced with delicate tannins and vibrant acidity. Riserva Ducale is made with carefully selected grapes that are fermented and macerated in stainless steel vats. The wine is then aged for 24 months in stainless steel vats and large oak casks. For the best flavor, store at room temperature, and then chill for 30 to 60 minutes before serving. This Italian red wine makes an excellent pairing with mushroom risotto or chicken cacciatore. Please enjoy our wines responsibly. 2026 Ruffino Import Company, Rutherford, CA

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Château de Saint Cosme is the leading estate of Gigondas and produces the appellation’s benchmark wines. Wine has been produced on the site of Saint Cosme since Roman times, evident by the ancient Gallo-Roman vats carved into the limestone below the château. The property has been in the hands of Louis Barruol’s family since 1490. Henri and Claude Barruol took over in 1957 and gradually moved Saint Cosme away from the bulk wine business. Henri was one of the first in the region to work organically beginning in the 1970s. Louis Barruol took over from his father in 1992, making a dramatic shift to quality, adding a négociant arm to the business in 1997, and converting to biodynamics in 2010.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The story behind PHNB begins in the mid-90s. Several ranchers got together to discuss the current trends in the beef industry and how to add value to beef products. They discovered that they were all experiencing the same confusion. Why is it that I am producing top quality cattle and yet all I hear at grocery stores and restaurants is that beef isn't as good as it used to be? As it turned out, the cattle that came from the ranches of Wheeler County were being lost in the mix of cattle from all over North America. Their cattle were being blended into pens that held cattle of lower quality. This beef, in turn, was being sent to the market and restaurants, resulting in unhappy consumers. Those ranchers decided to do something. They formed a corporation called Painted Hills Premium Beef, Inc. the groundwork for Painted Hills Natural Beef. The Natural Beef name was born out of a desire to better reflect the focus of the organization.  Painted Hills Natural beef is raised with No Added Hormones, No Antibiotics, Pasture Raised and fed a 100% Vegetarian Diet. Our cattle are never fed animal by-products of any kind. This is beef you can trust.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The story behind PHNB begins in the mid-90s. Several ranchers got together to discuss the current trends in the beef industry and how to add value to beef products. They discovered that they were all experiencing the same confusion. Why is it that I am producing top quality cattle and yet all I hear at grocery stores and restaurants is that beef isn't as good as it used to be? As it turned out, the cattle that came from the ranches of Wheeler County were being lost in the mix of cattle from all over North America. Their cattle were being blended into pens that held cattle of lower quality. This beef, in turn, was being sent to the market and restaurants, resulting in unhappy consumers. Those ranchers decided to do something. They formed a corporation called Painted Hills Premium Beef, Inc. the groundwork for Painted Hills Natural Beef. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: In our family, a dinner party is not complete without tortilla chips, salsa, and guacamole. Our grain free chips are dairy-free, powered by avocado oil, and made with natural ingredients (and lots of love!). With a selection of flavors like Sea Salt, Lime, Nacho, Fuego, Ranch, Sal y Limón, and No Salt, we hope there’s a flavor that speaks to everyone. Delicious as a solo act or in queso, bean dip, or hot sauce—but the real magic is when our tortilla chips are enjoyed with family and friends around the table. Our Grain Free Tortilla Chips come in all different flavors, shapes and sizes! Our five-ounce tortilla chips are large format, light and crispy cantina-style tortilla chips, while our four-ounce tortilla chips are smaller, thicker triangles full of seasoning: • Sea Salt (5oz) • Lime (5oz) • No Salt (5oz) • Nacho (5oz) • Fuego (4oz) • Ranch (4oz) • Sal y Limón (4oz) • Nacho (4oz)

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our Beginnings. When our founder, Steven, and his wife, Sara Jade, became parents, they placed a newfound value on living a more natural, sustainable lifestyle. In Sara Jade’s search for clean personal care products, she became frustrated by confusing natural claims and long, complicated ingredient lists, and learned that only products with an organic certification can be trusted to be pure, less processed, and more effective than commonly available alternatives. This inspired them to create their own products, and Sky Organics was born. Simple, Botanically-Based Solutions. Our products are thoughtfully curated to complement and enhance your clean beauty routine, and are formulated with as few ingredients as possible. We only include ingredients that we know will effectively deliver desired benefits, and we offer many single-ingredient products because that is often all that is truly needed to effectively care for skin, hair, lashes, or eyebrows. Integrity and Transparency. Because organic is known to be the cleanest form of natural and is clearly defined and certified, we seek out organic ingredients whenever available. We know for certain that our ingredients are sustainably grown, harvested without chemicals or synthetic fillers, and maintain their natural integrity and potency. When we do occasionally use a non-organic ingredient, it’s always a thoughtful choice that weighs the ingredient’s beauty benefit versus its organic availability, and we clearly communicate this on our product labels. Created for All. It's important to us that clean, natural, organic solutions are available to and affordable for as many people as possible, regardless of who they are, what they look like, or where they live. With this in mind, we offer self care essentials for every skin type and hair type, with a wide variety of beauty benefits and uses. Join Our Journey. We invite you to redefine your everyday approach to beauty and embrace a more hopeful world with Sky Organics.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Chicken and Wild Rice Soup. This organic soup has tender organic chicken, wild and brown rice and a variety of organically grown vegetables. Parsley and other seasonings round out the flavor of this gluten free soup, bringing a classic recipe to a whole new level of goodness. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings or pair soups with a salad, sandwich or wrap. USDA Certified Organic and made with non-GMO ingredients, this organic chicken soup contains 11 grams of protein per can and is made with no MSG, high fructose corn syrup, artificial colors or artificial flavors. To prepare, simply pour it into a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl, heat until hot, stir and enjoy. Every spoonful of our microwave soup is satisfying to the last drop. The soup can is recyclable for easy disposal. In addition to our Chicken and Wild Rice, we offer Chicken Noodle, Vegetable Lentil and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Spicy Chicken Noodle Soup. This USDA Certified Organic soup is consciously crafted with non-GMO ingredients, including chicken meat with no antibiotics, egg noodles, carrots, and celery. Red jalapeno peppers and other spices add a fiery kick to every spoonful, creating an organic chicken noodle soup with a Medium heat level. With 13g of protein per container, this convenient canned soup makes it easy to be intentional about the way you stock your pantry. Enjoy the organic chicken soup on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a salad, sandwich, or wrap. To prepare, simply microwave on high for 2.5 to 3 minutes, or heat in a saucepan on the stove, stirring occasionally. Each 16.1 oz recyclable can contains two cups of microwave soup. In addition to Spicy Chicken Noodle, Pacific Foods offers Chicken and Wild Rice, Greek-Style Chicken Orzo Soup With Lemon and Herb, and more. At Pacific Foods, we’re dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Vegetable Lentil Soup. This organic soup has the rich flavor of lentils and black beans. Fire-roasted red peppers and vine-ripened tomatoes round out the flavor of this plant based soup. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings or pair soups with a salad, sandwich or wrap. USDA Certified Organic and made with non-GMO ingredients, this vegetable soup contains 14 grams of protein per can, is a good source of fiber* and is made with no MSG, high fructose corn syrup, artificial colors or artificial flavors added. Each 16.3-ounce recyclable can contains one serving. To prepare, pour into a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl, heat until hot, stir and enjoy. Microwave on high for 3 minutes and let stand for 1 minute. Every spoonful of our vegan soup is satisfying to the last drop. In addition to our Vegetable Lentil soup, we offer Chicken Noodle, Chicken and Wild Rice and more. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Feel fresh, comfortable, and confident every day with Sparkle Panty Liners for Women—plant-based daily pantiliners designed to support sensitive skin and gentle feminine care. These incredibly thin panty liners provide reliable protection without bulk, making them ideal for everyday freshness, light discharge, and backup protection during your period. Specifically Designed for Sensitive Skin Sparkle panty liners, liners, and pads for women are dermatologist tested and hypoallergenic, making them perfect for sensitive and irritation-prone skin. These plant-based pantiliners are gentle, rash-free, and free from harsh chemicals, helping keep your skin healthy and comfortable throughout the day. Softer than cotton panty liners and period pads, Sparkle products are designed to minimize friction and discomfort. Gentle Plant-Based Feminine Care Sparkle liners and sanitary pads for women are crafted with plant-based ingredients that are gentle on your skin. These daily panty liners and period pads contain no chlorine bleach, no dyes, and no fragrances, ensuring irritation-free feminine care. Unlike many organic panty liners or organic pads that use only a cotton top sheet, Sparkle products are thoughtfully made to deliver a truly eco-conscious option for your period care routine. Comfortable & Secure Fit Designed for maximum comfort, Sparkle panty liners feature a super-soft top layer that feels smooth against your skin. These flexible, incredibly thin pantiliners stay comfortably in place for everyday use. Sparkle liners and pads with wings are designed to move with your body, helping you feel confident and protected whether you’re at work, on the go, or relaxing at home. Reliable Leak-Proof Protection Experience peace of mind with Sparkle liners and pads. With a wider back design and rapid fluid distribution channels, these sanitary napkins and menstrual pads provide reliable, leak-proof protection you can trust. Stay dry and confident with these dependable natural pads for women, designed to support both daily wear and lighter period days. A Sustainable Period Care Brand Sparkle was founded with a mission to change the way periods are experienced—by offering eco-conscious, organic, plant-based feminine care products that are gentle on your body and mindful of the planet. Co-founders Hetal and Chirag are committed to transparency, comfort, and creating high-quality liners, panty liners, and sanitary pads that make a meaningful difference for menstruators around the world. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Effortlessly craft extraordinary meals with Pacific Foods Organic Chicken Stock. We slow-simmer organic chicken meat and bones with just the right amount of seasonings for a savory chicken stock that’s rich and full of flavor. Sophisticated in its simplicity, this stock adds depth and refined flavors to your favorite dishes. Use it in any recipe that calls for chicken stock, chicken broth or water. It’s great for braising and marinating chicken, beef and veggies, and it makes a delicious stew or soup base. It also enhances gravies and sauces and elevates the flavor in your favorite comfort foods. Our USDA-certified organic chicken stock is made from non-GMO ingredients and free ofgluten,soy,wheat and yeast. Each 1-cup serving contains 0 grams of fat, 1 gram of carbs and 30 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains approximately 4 servings. Pacific Foods also offers chicken broth, beef broth, turkey broth, vegetable broth and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Green, potent, and microscopic, chlorella is a single-celled freshwater algae celebrated for its dense nutrient profile and detox-supporting potential. Sunfood’s formula uses broken-cell-wall processing to disrupt the tough outer shell of the algae cells, making its internal nutrients more bioavailable. We are proud to process our chlorella into pressed tablets without the use of additional fillers or caking agents, just pure chlorella powder. The emerald green hue comes from chlorophyll, a compound known for purifying properties. With a combination of protein, iron, beta-carotene, and B vitamins, this algae tablet supports detox pathways, cellular health, and overall vitality. Whether you’re seeking to support your body’s natural cleansing systems or simply add a potent green superfood to your daily regimen, these tablets give you a concentrated boost in a compact form.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: "Golden milk has ancient roots in Ayurvedic tradition as a soothing, anti-inflammatory, and nourishing beverage. Sunfood’s Organic Golden Milk Super Blend brings that heritage into a modern format, combining turmeric’s signature benefits with adaptogens and spices for a richer, more balanced effect. The inclusion of black pepper is intentional: piperine from black pepper enhances the absorption of curcumin (turmeric’s active compound). Maca adds adaptogenic support, while goji, ginger, and cardamom round out the blend with flavor and phytonutrient depth. The end result is a comforting, aromatic latte-style drink that works as both a daily ritual and a functional supplement. Use it as a warm “golden milk” latte in the evening, or blend into smoothies, oatmeal, or even baked goods for a spicy, health-forward twist."

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: A Sunfood Superfood Orginal, we have been proud to offer Organic Maca Powder to our community for over 25 years! Hailed by the ancient Incas as a “food of the gods,” maca is a cruciferous root native to the high Peruvian Andes. Its traditional use spans centuries from endurance support for warriors to general wellness tonic for everyday use. Sunfood’s Organic Maca Powder is crafted from maca roots harvested at high elevation, gently dried, and finely milled to preserve its phytonutrients. Unlike processed or roasted versions, this raw format aims to retain adaptogenic compounds. Users often turn to maca for natural support to hormonal health, energy, mood, and stress balance. Because each scoop contributes micronutrients along with adaptogens, it’s a functional addition to smoothies, elixirs, oats, or baked goods.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee—the perfect blend of sweet and salty indulgence! This fan-favorite bar combines 42% dark milk chocolate with crunchy pretzel pieces and a sweet toffee crunch. Each bite is an irresistible combination of rich dark milk chocolate, salty pretzel pieces, and the sweet, chewy goodness of toffee. Wrapped in a vibrant purple wrapper, it’s a candy that’s as fun to look at as it is to eat! At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should do more than just taste great—it should make a difference. That’s why our Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the 42% dark milk chocolate, the crunch of the pretzels, and the sweet, buttery flavor of the toffee. Whether you’re enjoying a sweet snack, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of creamy dark milk chocolate, crunchy pretzels, and sweet toffee, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s changing the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony's Chocolonely Milk Chocolate Bar is a silky-smooth and downright delicious 32% milk chocolate bar that's changing the chocolate industry. These vibrant red-wrapped wonders are made with traceable cocoa and exist to support the wellbeing of cocoa farmers and their families. Our all-natural bars were Fairtrade Certified from the start and made with outstanding non-GMO ingredients. You’ll notice that each bar has a dynamic, uneven pattern that makes it a bit difficult to share equally. With these unequal divisions, we present an important story about the inequality along the chocolate supply chain. Share a bar of our outstanding milk chocolate and in doing so, help us share our recipe for slave-free chocolate. Includes one 1.8 oz. Milk Chocolate Bar. Right now, slaves are working on cocoa farms in West Africa. Many of them are children. Tony's Chocolonely exists to change that. Our vision is 100% slave-free chocolate. Not just our chocolate, but all chocolate worldwide. With incredibly tasty chocolate, we lead by example to show the world chocolate can be made differently. The more people choose slave-free and share our story, the sooner 100% slave-free becomes the norm in chocolate. The choice is yours. Are you in?

Every bite delivers a melt-in-your-mouth experience that’s simple, delicious, and utterly satisfying. At Tony’s, we believe chocolate should do more than just taste good—it should make a difference. That’s why our Milk Chocolate Bar with 32% Cocoa is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a tasty chocolate bar; you’re supporting a movement that promotes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for cocoa farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support our farmers to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. This Milk Chocolate Bar with 32% Cocoa is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the smooth, creamy texture of the milk chocolate, delivering a rich cocoa flavor that’s perfectly sweetened. It’s a classic that never goes out of style. Whether you’re indulging yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Milk Chocolate Bar with 32% Cocoa is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate balance of creamy milk chocolate and Fairtrade cocoa, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—indulge with a bar that’s as flavorful as it is meaningful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s changing the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony’s Rainbow Tasting Pack is the perfect way to experience the best of Tony’s chocolate in one colorful and fun package. This variety pack features 6 of our most beloved flavors, offering something for every chocolate lover. From the smooth, creamy texture of Milk Chocolate to the indulgent sweetness of Milk Caramel Sea Salt, this pack has all the delicious options you crave. The Milk Chocolate Nougat delivers a chewy, satisfying bite, while the Dark Almond Sea Salt bar brings a perfect balance of bold, rich dark chocolate with crunchy almonds and a touch of sea salt. If you’re a fan of deep cocoa, the 70% Dark Chocolate is the perfect choice for a more intense chocolate experience. All these bars come in our bright, cheerful rainbow packaging, making it a fun gift or a vibrant addition to your snack stash. At Tony’s, we believe that great chocolate should make a positive impact. That’s why each bar is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa, supporting cocoa farmers to get paid a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. By choosing Tony’s, you’re supporting a movement for a more sustainable, ethical, and transparent chocolate industry. Whether you’re sharing with friends, yourself, or looking for a thoughtful gift, the Rainbow Tasting Pack offers a wide variety of flavors that will satisfy every chocolate craving. The fun, colorful packaging makes it ideal for gifting during any celebration, and with its mix of classic milk and dark chocolate options, everyone can find their favorite. So why not indulge yourself or someone you love to a colorful and exciting experience that does good for the world as well as for your taste buds? With every purchase of the Rainbow Tasting Pack, you’re not just enjoying the finest chocolate—you’re contributing to a fairer chocolate industry.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s The Everything Bar—the chocolate bar that truly has it all! This indulgence is packed with 32% milk chocolate, caramel, almond nougat, pretzel, and a touch of sea salt. Each bite offers a perfect blend of creamy, crunchy, salty, and sweet flavors that come together in one irresistible bar. It’s the ultimate chocolate experience for anyone who loves bold Belgian chocolate and a bit of everything! At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should be more than just a tasty snack—it should make a difference. That’s why we’re on a mission to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. Every bar of The Everything Bar is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Everything Bar is a prime example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the milk chocolate, followed by the satisfying crunch of the pretzels, the sweet indulgence of the caramel, and the chewy delight of the almond nougat. A hint of sea salt ties it all together, creating a harmonious balance of flavors that’s simply unforgettable. Whether you’re indulging yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, The Everything Bar is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate balance of flavors, all in one indulgent, delicious chocolate bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—introduce yourself to a bar that’s as fun as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

This advanced natural formulation works while you sleep with Glycablend™, our very own potent seed oil complex inspiring more supple-looking skin, a youthful appearance, and co-enzyme Q10 which helps fight free radical damage. MARRYING NATURE WITH SCIENCE. With a primary goal rooted in our purpose of marrying the intelligence of both nature and science, we uncover beauty that runs deep beneath the surface. Pioneers and experts in pure natural plant oils and clean beauty formulations, we ensure all our products work in harmony to restore skin’s vitality and radiance, leaving behind only naturally glowing skin. NO FILLERS NECESSARY. Our approach to skincare is to use clean, natural ingredients that offer peak results. We never add anything to our products unless it’s absolutely necessary. That means no fillers - just potent, clean formulations for glowing, happy skin. Our beauty oils have a BioGro organic certification which allows us to trace the origins of our beauty oils, ensuring they’re both organic and fair-trade. Our NATRUE certification guarantees animals are kept safe and there’s no trace of cruelty involved in the making of our skincare. TALK THE TALK. It’s important to us that we walk the walk AND talk the talk. To do so, we carry out user trials on all Trilogy skincare products to collect unbiased data about our formulations. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: INTRODUCING ROSAPENE™. Rosepene™ is an all-star skincare ingredient that deeply penetrates the skin surface to nourish and hydrate your skin from the inside out. MARRYING NATURE WITH SCIENCE. With a primary goal rooted in our purpose of marrying the intelligence of both nature and science, we uncover beauty that runs deep beneath the surface. Pioneers and experts in pure natural plant oils and clean beauty formulations, we ensure all our products work in harmony to restore skin's vitality and radiance, leaving behind only naturally glowing skin. NO FILLERS NECESSARY. Our approach to skincare is to use clean, natural ingredients that offer peak results. We never add anything to our products unless it's absolutely necessary. That means no fillers - just potent, clean formulations for glowing, happy skin. In the beauty industry, we believe in our responsibility to minimize our impact on the environment and to continually evolve in this direction. Our corporate operations are carbon zero certified, and we've been carbon neutral since 2007. Bonus points: Our products have been globally awarded for being ocean-friendly, reef-safe and biodegradable. NATRUE + BIOGRO CERTIFIED. We thrive off knowing where our ingredients come from and making sure animals aren’t harmed in the process. Our beauty oils have a BioGro organic certification which allows us to trace the origins of our beauty oils, ensuring they're both organic and fair-trade. Our NATRUE certification guarantees animals are kept safe and there’s no trace of cruelty involved in the making of our skincare. TALK THE TALK. It's important to us that we walk the walk AND talk the talk. To do so, we carry out user trials on all Trilogy skincare products to collect unbiased data about our formulations. We also work with like-minded suppliers of clean ingredients who bring their own manufacturing data to the table. Trust is key in providing for our customers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Soothe your hands with gentle care. Weleda Unscented Hand Cream is a fast absorbing hand cream with jojoba, borage and coconut oils that uses nature's restorative power to gently moisturize so hands feel silky-soft. Easily absorbed and made for sensitive hands prone to irritation and redness, this fragrance free hand cream helps strengthen the skin’s own protective layer. Weleda personal care products are dermatologically tested with no synthetic fragrances, colors, preservatives and raw materials derived from mineral oils and never tested on animals. In Switzerland 1921, Weleda was founded on the belief that people are part of nature, grounded in a commitment to carefully orchestrate formulas that work with the body’s rhythms to awaken skin’s natural functions. Weleda is still creating those products today, that recognize the power of the natural world to balance mind, body and spirit allowing your beauty to shine through.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The Yerba Prima Tampico Skin Brush is a wonderful, revitalizing health and beauty aid. Removing the top layer of dead skin and stimulating the circulation of blood feeding the skin are essential for maintaining youthful, glowing and supple skin. Skin Brushing has been used throughout the world for centuries, and is making its way back into popularity. Dry skin brushing is one of the best ways to cleanse the skin without removing the protective mantle of acid and oils. It gently and effectively removes the top layer of dead skin cells with its build-up of dirt and acid, and deeply cleanses the pores. Skin brushing is one of the most powerful ways to cleanse the lymphatic system. Waste material is carried away from the cells by the blood and the lymph. Skin brushing stimulates the release of this material from the cells near the surface of the body. Eventually, most of the toxins along with their carrier cells, primarily lymphocytes, find their way to the colon for elimination. Skin brushing is also used by beauty salons as part of a program for removing cellulite. Skin brushing is most effective with an all-natural vegetable fiber brush, such as the Tampico Skin Brush. Make sure the brush isn t made of synthetic fiber since this can irritate the skin. A long handle is also helpful for reaching the back and entire body.

whole_foods_store_price_differences.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

recommendations.title: Prefer source-backed rules over broad keyword guessing
recommendations.detail: Use reliable source fields like Fresh Produce, retailer breadcrumbs, and product-detail metadata before adding keyword rules that can move drinks, supplements, or personal care into the wrong shelf.

recommendations.title: Use gold labels as training data
recommendations.detail: Pick representative products from repeated failed brands and product families. One good label can help a whole cluster through the local text model.
